name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: Did You See What We Did TODAY?
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=1)
---
Peter \-- **We scored some HUGE points today!** The State Fair is off to a booming success. Our booth has been a major hit. There's buzz all around fairgrounds about it. In fact, the lines are even bigger than last year.
## Check this out:
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/huge_first_day_for_our_dump_walz_booth_at_the_state_fair?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=2) All day we had thousands of people coming up to the booth, spinning the wheel, giving us a big thumbs up and signing our Never Again and Give it Back petitions. We're building a MASSIVE movement to take back our state. And the people could not be more fired up to Dump Walz. Meanwhile, down the street from us, Tim Walz' tiny booth wasn't getting much action... The State Fair acts as an early gauge of where things stand in the November election. That must be scaring the crap out of the Radical Left. As I've told you many times, they resort to lies and propaganda to win elections. We just go out there and tell the cold, hard truth.
## That's why people love us!
But I've got to ask a favor of you. I just left the fairgrounds and my staff and the volunteers are overwhelmed. There are too many people coming to our booth. I know, I know...that's a good thing. But long lines mean people have to wait to hear our message. And I have to hire some additional workers IMMEDIATELY. Like the saying goes - strike while the iron is hot. Well, it's **RED HOT**. We can, and we will, CRUSH TIM WALZ at the State Fair this year. **Can you please rush in a donation to help us increase our State Fair operations immediately!** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=3 "Yes, I'd like to Donate") [Yes, I'd like to Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=3)
---
You wouldn't believe how much we gave away today in merchandise. Boxes and boxes of stuff by the time I left. And there's still a couple hours of fair time left today.
We've been planning this booth for months, but in our wildest imagination, couldn't believe how many people we'd get.
At our current rate, we're going to be running out of "Walz Failed" hats by this weekend.
## Unbelievable!
This could not be going any better! I'm thrilled for the next 11 days.
Our message is getting out to hundreds of thousands of voters a day. And by the time the fair is over, well over a million people will see our popular "Dump Walz" booth.
At our booth, voters are being reminded of Tim Walz' anti-liberty lockdowns, COVID mandates, failure to stop crime and how he is holding onto our $12 Billion of surplus money.
We have an incredibly important message to tell.
And a very, very receptive audience.
But we'll need to order more merchandise and hire more staffers so we can meet this HUGE demand. I desperately need your help.
Help me CRUSH TIM WALZ at the State Fair!
[**Please rush in a $25, $50, $100 or even $500 donation so I can immediately expand our state fair booth operations! This is the last chance we have to put our message in front of this many people.**](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=4)
Thank you in advance.
**In Liberty,**
****
**Jake Duesenberg**
**President, Action 4 Liberty**
Action 4 Liberty
1920 Oakcrest Ave #5
Roseville, MN 55113
Action 4 Liberty · United States
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://www.action4liberty.com/unsubscribe?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=5).
You can also keep up with Jake Duesenberg on [Facebook](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nyVoJL5zCIi1gu8lCoYmQrA8P7rhuOjJmdy-IRmglie&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_1_of_state_fair&n=6).

| [](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=3ce52cb5f39241bbb9bace5bdb95f27a&_e=q6wMLsleB_G0e-BOkN7HdZPvarOKuLB121R9m9D4pqzbRf3-ioN71ONNK4omh98vp8WAYgV5BvgrMEpfypM7LYKfbp5jSoVYPXN6D1TVVFY5rx-QY4OVO_P02-B7MI5ZTOHgqheR3sJ3I5u6eQjreoCsh9TLzEyAT8VSgH5-43h6ezUvP-WHVHVz4QpLV_Pw2i9iIxUX5quXLU9-FU2J4tGLPMKLARPyg40g7riMpQHU24ZU3RT72Lzs9_fsJ2-5iJhzOGd97a9zRrIW05FXY5CirV6sJozOGibGEf1dXTu4qnpNOY-0C2u_bAjdBSVKK1aoOTp0skib3nEUDW_XzXr0ep08JsGP_x-mkdEqaqf6fEwK798l5irA1GCqKO2fb2NHv6EPTdaWQfGL5GaossKps6PMLrEXL5N5l2MyNhBz2dSoL-N3WMwcc3ZMyMAeTh5Z_aMt49qdQlFzhFChiWeMnnBDPiwG2YviFuLsGw0%3D)
---
Friends,

I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=3ce52cb5f39241bbb9bace5bdb95f27a&_e=q6wMLsleB_G0e-BOkN7HdZPvarOKuLB121R9m9D4pqzbRf3-ioN71ONNK4omh98vp8WAYgV5BvgrMEpfypM7LYKfbp5jSoVYPXN6D1TVVFY5rx-QY4OVO_P02-B7MI5ZTOHgqheR3sJ3I5u6eQjreoCsh9TLzEyAT8VSgH5-43h6ezUvP-WHVHVz4QpLV_Pw2i9iIxUX5quXLU9-FU2J4tGLPMKLARPyg40g7riMpQHU24ZU3RT72Lzs9_fsJ2-5iJhzOGd97a9zRrIW05FXY5CirV6sJozOGibGEf1dXTt6hqxZ674-XH1X5mSCiejr6uzwC6Fb7jh3yxAj1Y6OZVhGE0m7RwCl1ZRYAEC-KFAQARfEWo8yNTXetoHx7B6axp_YY2DRTVLcFLEF1AezCJ-_HOCy-cASjuHtTZedhUdVrOS4odgB-WWLtoM_U7sLsCh8eNmQIu-aBhbg_kQ_fNfsBTsNc4jGByLAbLroeTI%3D)
This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=3ce52cb5f39241bbb9bace5bdb95f27a&_e=q6wMLsleB_G0e-BOkN7HdZPvarOKuLB121R9m9D4pqzbRf3-ioN71ONNK4omh98vp8WAYgV5BvgrMEpfypM7LYKfbp5jSoVYPXN6D1TVVFY5rx-QY4OVO_P02-B7MI5ZTOHgqheR3sJ3I5u6eQjreoCsh9TLzEyAT8VSgH5-43h6ezUvP-WHVHVz4QpLV_Pw2i9iIxUX5quXLU9-FU2J4tGLPMKLARPyg40g7riMpQHU24ZU3RT72Lzs9_fsJ2-5iJhzOGd97a9zRrIW05FXY5CirV6sJozOGibGEf1dXTt6hqxZ674-XH1X5mSCiejr6uzwC6Fb7jh3yxAj1Y6OZQeTJR-Jx89YJsikILQAwK0lMGHyCryfpexNPzCoo0zGIw9jf-10DAl-mUjiSWqJLViwL8fAFBhAP9VEo5YZ7mX9PEXy-eKkLrkEQwXvRLUDlHBueV2KTG8jxa5Z8bCPFSFU_A_cNke9x1Ec3VNs_cY%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.

Every Texan needs to know that Abbott chose to outlaw abortion beginning at conception with no exception for rape or incest.
#
**Greg Abbott's dangerous abortion ban officially goes into effect today.** This ban — that Greg Abbott brags about signing — is a direct attack on the freedom, health, and lives of Texas women.
So we're holding Abbott fully accountable. Every Texan needs to know that Abbott chose to outlaw abortion beginning at conception with no exception for rape or incest.
That's why we just released the first TV ad of our campaign to spread the word about Abbott's dangerous and unpopular law. [We need to make sure millions of Texans see this, so please chip in now to help us get it in front of more voters.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220825-3.vSjRM8&refcode=ema20220825-204804&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=204804%2E444211%2EP9l93C)

Bring a smile, sunscreen, comfortable shoes, and light-colored pants or skirt to go with your Karina Tshirt. Download the Campaign Sidekick app for Apple or Android, and be sure your phone is fully charged. The campaign will provide Tshirts (you know you want one), training, support, bottled water, and snacks. After door knocking training and a pep talk from Karina, we will send you into the neighborhood in teams; no one goes alone! Return to Karina HQ afterward for refreshments and to share any stories Karina should hear.
Please rsvp so we can plan resources appropriately.

[cid:95a5d82a-eb4a-427c-b263-aa7620a81e22]

---
Dear Peter, My name is Eddie Gallagher, I'm a former Navy SEAL whose twenty-year career of fighting for our country came to an abrupt end when corrupt prosecutors tried to lock me up on false charges. After years of successfully fighting to clear my name, I started Pipe Hitter Foundation to help other soldiers and first responders who are being unjustly prosecuted just for doing their job. _And today I have a shocking story to tell you_. I am reaching out to share this story about **Ben Darby... A wrongly accused officer in need of our support. ** Ben was a well-trained Huntsville police officer who was forced to make a difficult split-second decision while responding to a dangerous 911 call. The situation was cleared by the Incident Review Board, and Ben's actions were deemed justified. It was determined that he followed all applicable policies and laws. However, soon after Ben was cleared, the Huntsville District Attorney began to use him and his case as a political football. They offered him multiple plea deals, but Ben Darby firmly believed his actions were justified and resisted all pleas. **_Ben was sentenced to 25 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. He is not eligible for an appeal bond due to the excessive sentence he was given. He is stuck serving day-for-day until his appeal comes through. _**
---

The Pipe Hitter Foundation (PHF) was founded to defend the rights and freedoms of our men and women in uniform... The same rights and freedoms they risk their lives to uphold.**This is why we support Ben Darby in his fight for justice and are requesting your aid to help him get through this time of need and clear his name.** **[Please help us reach our Campaign Goal of $100,000 to support Officer Ben Darby during this time of financial difficulty, as court fees and additional expenses quickly add up. Chip-in $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today to help Ben clear his name.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61098292:6byVulVnN:m:1:3317145305:19CF20F4AB927EACE3516C1C498B3105:r)**

---
The District Attorney wrongfully charged Ben with murder, which kicked off a years-long prosecution that became riddled with ethical lapses, prosecutorial misconduct, errant rulings, and politics. **Officer Darby's jury was prevented from hearing relevant testimony from witnesses that would have exonerated him.** Ben and his wife, Keelin Darby, are now in the fight of their lives to appeal this ruling and request a fair shot at justice. The PHF team has set a campaign goal of $100,000 to help Officer Darby pay off court fees, legal expenses, and other additional costs. Ben risked his life every day on the job to help others... Now it's our turn to give him the help he urgently needs. **Officer Ben Darby is facing unfair legal and financial hardships. He urgently needs our support. PHF is here to help, but we can** '**t do it without aid from supportive community members like you. ** **[Our men and women in blue deserve so much more than this. body:
|
| | | Hey Peter,

I wanted to take a minute and tell my story - _**about why I support Tiffany Smiley.**_

I grew up in a very close-knit family in a small town. Our whole family, aunts, uncles, and cousins would come over every Sunday night for dinner, and we would tell stories about our lives.

As far as I knew, my uncle was just a pilot, but I eventually learned he was a fighter pilot in the Marine Corps for over 20 years! I was always confused why he would get sad, anxious, or upset when people would ask questions.

When I was old enough, I discovered he was shot down in the Gulf War and taken prisoner for 90+ days. He was the only person on the plane to survive.

He came home after the war and hasn't been the same since.

They honorably discharged him yet never provided access to the mental health services that he needed. Care that he _earned_.

When I heard about Tiffany's story, _**I felt that there was someone out there who cared about bettering service members' lives after their time, not just during. **_

The more I read about her and listen to her interviews, the more I realize how much _our country needs a leader like Tiffany._

Tiffany Smiley not only wants to improve the lives of America's veterans but the futures of our children, the health of our economy, and to help us all achieve our American Dreams.
_**[She isn't just only a leader to want; she's a leader America needs.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61098894:JUb_llVBN:m:1:3253819041:12E973A90774C565391341FCE16EAD39:r "She isn’t just only a leader to want; she’s a leader America needs. ")**_
We're now in the final days until the General Election, and I'm encouraging you to step up NOW!

Being a Team Smiley member, I've witnessed the _incredible_ grassroots support behind this campaign. It's truly something special, and I promise you'll want to be a part of this history-making campaign.

TIFFANY?")
---

Tiffany Smiley is running in the #1 race to watch. She's facing 30-year incumbent Patty Murray and is promoting an optimistic message of hope for the future of America.

_Simply put, we need Tiffany in the U.S. Senate._

She never gave up on our veterans and will never give up on America, so there is no reason we should give up on her.

---
| | [DON'T GIVE UP](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61098894:JUb_llVBN:m:1:3253819041:12E973A90774C565391341FCE16EAD39:r "DON’T GIVE UP")

With your help, Tiffany can go into November prepared with the best grassroots team behind her.

Thank you for listening to my story, and, just like Tiffany - _**[don't give up.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61098894:JUb_llVBN:m:1:3253819041:12E973A90774C565391341FCE16EAD39:r "don’t give up.")**_

Best,

Anna
_Team Smiley_

subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6385%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=R%2bEG4g7rMPtXIzrXVCbkvA&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75823%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aMU%2fglxKmZcpvJU5vSH1EA&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75824%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xdSPyvA9AU7RBhhre5QLZg&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. Friend,

President Biden thinks that he can imagine a recession away by simply denying it exists.

The truth is that central planners like Biden must deny reality to fulfill their political ambitions--often with deadly and disastrous consequences.

Friend, this reminds me of a Ron Paul quote: _**" Truth is treason in the empire of lies. And our economy is built upon lies." **_

I'm thinking of lies such as these:
* Deficits and debt can pile up without limit.
* High taxes on cigarettes discourage smoking, but high taxes on investment and employment do little or no harm.
* Earning a profit is somehow anti-social.
* Russian dictators caused American inflation.

The only way to see through lies is to have an educated populace.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Lawrence Reed, President Emeritus for the Foundation of Economic Education (FEE).

FEE is working to provide pro-liberty, free-market economic education to high school students across the country through _FEE in the Classroom_ this fall.

[_**It costs roughly $50 to sponsor a student. Will you chip in to sponsor a student today? Click here to donate >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zibemuq599btrp2alputg3v43r3tk4qum9t1r7m0_rp22sh2s8i66or4clg61o32c5h2bs)

The U.S. has posted negative growth for the second quarter in a row.

The news prompted many outlets, including The Wall Street Journal, to use the R-word: recession. But don't worry, Friend, Biden has said the U.S. economy is _" on the right path."_

Biden's comment may come as a surprise to you and me. But Biden's Establishment is content with where our economy is heading.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently stated, _" We have a very strong labor market. When you are creating almost 400,000 jobs a month, that is not a recession."_

Keep in mind that they are conveniently ignoring the thousands of jobs lost during the pandemic lockdowns, which Biden also caused.

The high school students that go through _FEE in the Classroom_ would never fall for the nonsense of changing definitions to hide economic reality. They also learn that there is no good substitute for strong personal character.

All you have to do is look around your average US city to see the economic struggles--decay, crime, parents working multiple jobs to make ends meet.

[_**That 's why I'm reaching out and asking you to become a Student Sponsor for FEE in the Classroom. Click here to change a high school student's life >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z20bmmhoaiglmig2hmr6edmh7sp5jm2g0hpu61hg_rp22sh2s8i66or4clg61o32c5h2bs)

_**FEE in the Classroom**_ is a unique program held in brick-and-mortar and virtual classrooms across the country that teaches young Americans the principles of free markets, individual liberty, and limited government.

_**This program uniquely challenges high school students to think outside the box, to challenge the mainstream narrative.**_

On an average day, 75-300 students engage with FEE's faculty of acclaimed instructors through compelling lectures, exciting economic experiments, engaging group discussions, and Q&As.

Students learn how the core principles of individual liberty and free-market economics apply to their daily lives, communities, careers, and the state of the nation.

Thousands of young Americans have come to understand the positive impact freedom has on their lives, their communities, and our country through _FEE in the Classroom_ workshops.

In fact, one of the most frequently asked questions afterward is: _" Why haven't I heard these ideas before?"_

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr16r99g78qfuc1000jlcvi4msoj28v6k06se8lg_rp22sh2s8i66or4clg61o32c5h2bs)

The ideas of individualism, liberty, and free markets are under attack by constant propaganda in the U.S, and socialism is gaining ground once again.
* Major leaders in Congress are openly socialist (Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez), calling on 70% income taxes and a Green New Deal, which would essentially take over our economy.
* Roughly 18% of social scientists in the United States self-identify as Marxists.
* Perhaps most alarmingly, opinion polls show that more young Americans have a favorable view of socialism than capitalism.

Young Americans need to know that there is an alternative. You and I need to enable these students to learn about the ideals of liberty and economic freedom.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4mu36r7lo91ta0096dk9231cljqka9e0vrbqtb0_rp22sh2s8i66or4clg61o32c5h2bs)

Friend, I've experienced socialism first hand, and I know the effects it can have on people--that's why I want students to learn about the horrors of socialism through education, not first-hand like me.

I was in Poland in the 1980s with one mission in mind.**I needed to do everything I could to bring the ideas of free markets and liberty to people in the communist bloc. **

I smuggled books (and raised money to support book smuggling) into Eastern European countries such as Poland and the Soviet Union itself.

I was a smuggler of liberty, free thought, and economic freedom.

Friend, the Soviets banned learning about these ideals to keep people in the dark about their actions.

Now Biden is trying to change a word's definition for personal gain. He would manipulate and lie to the entire country rather than tell the truth.

As Voltaire said, "**Anyone who can make you believe absurdities can make you commit atrocities. " **

This is alarming, but I need you to read:
**Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire.**
This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority – it's bad for our democracy.
Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024."
And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly.
Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward.
With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at _Roe_ being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate.

Hello,
It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** An opportunity to come clean for my opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to occur.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are raising boatloads to spend against me. I am the ultimate “hard target” for the Republicans, but to get elected, **I need your help. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs – instead, I’m relying entirely on grassroots donors _like you_.**

subject: Healing, forgiveness and redemption
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:

---
Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106441:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **" The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106441:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)
Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage.

**[I need your help to combat their vulgar, gutless attacks against me. Please donate to our media fund right now so we can refute the lies Democrats are peddling and set the record straight.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106441:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)**

[** DONATE $25 -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106442:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r) [** DONATE $50 -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106443:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r) [** DONATE $75 -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106444:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r) [** DONATE $100 -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106445:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)
With high gasoline prices, skyrocketing inflation, increasing taxes, and rising crime at the forefront of voters' minds, it's easy to see why my opponents don't want to talk about the issues. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally.

**The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you.**

Thanks,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106441:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)

Herschel Walker

P.S. The topic of mental health is so important to me that I recently wrote an op-ed in the _Wall Street Journal_ with much of the information contained in this email. In spite of the attacks, I will never stop my efforts to help others.

[** DONATE TODAY -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61106441:JMeLhlVN1:m:1:3331421248:F2758718116FD72447D45A5369C33001:r)

I’ve stood by Michael as he’s campaigned, so I’m deeply familiar with just how rough and challenging these final months of the race can be. And midterm election years when your party has the White House are notoriously tough. Michael won his last midterm re-election by just 1.7%. That’s fewer than 30,000 votes out of almost 2 million cast! So when Mitch McConnell described his opponent as his “perfect candidate” and bought a quarter of a million dollars of ads in our state, I knew this race would only get tougher. When you’re running a people-powered campaign like Michael’s, you have to stay on top of your fundraising from month-to-month. But Michael’s team told me they’ve hit a summer slump, just as his self-funding opponent’s campaign picked up steam with support from the National GOP. And it’s no secret corporate special interests are angry that Michael has challenged their status quo. The National GOP has raised over $330 million to flip seats like Michael’s and put Mitch McConnell in charge. They’re doing everything they can to oust Senators like Michael who stood firm against Mitch’s obstruction to help working families over corporate special interests.
Since people like you helped elect him, Michael:
* Capped prescription drug costs for seniors;
* Passed legislation to ensure parents and guardians on WIC could purchase the baby formula they need in the wake of the formula shortage;
* Reformed our tax codes so corporations like Amazon pay their fair share;
* Passed the expanded Child Tax Credit to help struggling families pay for things like childcare, then ramped up his fight to make it permanent;
* Introduced legislation to protect women who cross state lines for abortions and the providers that support them;
* And he secured funding for road and bridge repairs that will create good-paying jobs here in Colorado.

Folks like Mitch McConnell and Rick Scott — chair of the GOP Senate campaign arm — are emboldened by a poll that put Michael down 1% to a GOP opponent and back-to-back rankings that show his seat in the top 10 most likely to flip this November.
They’re bankrolling attack ads nationwide and already have operatives on the ground in Colorado to distort Michael’s record and flip our state.
I’ve stood by Michael in tough races before. I know he can hold this seat with people like you powering his campaign.

I want to chat with you about my husband Eric.

Hi folks – It's been a while since I checked in with you, and I wanted to talk about today, Women's Equality Day. Today commemorates the 1920 passage of the 19th Amendment, which granted women the right to vote. It's also a time to reflect on the hurdles that women had to overcome in the suffrage movement and the barriers that still exist for women today. **Republicans have brought the fight for women's rights to the forefront of history once again.** Every day, women across the country are under attack – being forced into decisions on voting, healthcare, education, and financial insecurity against their will. When Eric and I discussed his passion to run for Congress, and that he would be running against one of the most right-wing Republicans out there, no less, I thought he was dreaming. But, when he told me his motivation, ensuring that our daughter (and everyone’s daughter) does not have to grow up in a world where her Representatives have no respect for her or her choices, I reconsidered. **We need more elected officials who stand up for the rights of those in their communities, no matter their gender identity.** We need to elect someone who puts people first, like Eric, who understands that they need to listen to the communities, like women, that are most affected by policies created in Washington. Since the beginning of his career, Eric has had that mentality – of listening, collaborating with others, and doing what's right. I know that with his leadership, Pinellas County and our country will be a safer place for every woman and everyone. **[But, we also know what's at stake if he doesn't win. name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Ron DeSantis has turned Florida and America into a danger zone. Everyone knows he wants to run for president from his post as Governor of Florida. But Charlie Crist has enough of a reputation in Florida that he poses a real challenge to DeSantis if he can get his message out.
body:
Charlie Crist for Florida!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Ron DeSantis has turned Florida and America into a danger zone.** **A clownish, crude and colic disgrace to Florida. The examples are endless.** His firing Rebekah Jones from the Health Dept--as we've written you about--for keeping accurate COVID numbers, ones that would show how many Floridians he actually allowed to get sick and die by ignoring the crisis (Florida ended up suffering more than any other state). He sent state officers into her home, to point guns at her children and threaten her, when he found out she was continuing to keep track of COVID numbers on her own. DeSantis punished Disney for being inclusive to the gay & lesbian community, he punished the Tampa Bay Rays for sharing accurate information on gun violence via their Twitter feed and, most recently, he suspended a Tampa prosecutor, Adam Warren, who said he wouldn't prosecute abortion cases because the state's previous laws on privacy and abortion are still unclear. **[So can you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Charlie Crist, so we can stop the totalitarian DeSantis from further destroying Florida, and ever getting his grubby little hands on the United States?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5cf83add-ec74-42a3-8f42-4b4866ba9730/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **DeSantis is dictatorial, degrading and an enemy of American democracy. **_But even all of that couldn't prepare us for the video he just released "Top Gov," a takeoff on Top Gun so cringe-inducing that it's impossible to watch and not keel over from second-hand embarrassment. _ _DeSantis puts on a flight suit to--which is stolen valor, he was a military lawyer, but he never served in combat--and a helmet on his oversized nugget that is so tight it makes it look like he's squeezing a melon through hoop earring. _ **_Desantis is as unserious as he is evil, and if we don't stop him now, he will have a good shot at being President in 2024, as lunatics like Alex Jones--who, sadly, have a ton of influence in today's GOP--line up behind him._** _**The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. **_
---

| _**Crist wil fight for abortion rights, gun safety, policies to battle climate change, universal voting rights and he believes in democracy, not the dictatorship DeSanis has foisted upon Florida--and would do to the United States, if given the chance.**_ **_As a former Governor, Attorney General & current Congressman, Crist has great name recognition, and as a former Republican, a ton of appeal to former moderate Republicans horrified at what their party's become because of men like DeSantis. Recent polls show him within a few points of DeSantis, and focus groups show undecided voters mostly repelled by DeSantis. _** _When Crist ran against incumbent Governor Rick Scott in 2014, he lost by less than one point, even though Scott spent tens of millions of his own money-_ -or perhaps we should accurately call it his ill-gotten gains from overseeing the largest Medicare fraud case in U.S. history. **Crist can win. He can even be outspent and win. But, after a tough primary, Ron DeSantis has an ENORMOUS FINANCIAL ADVANTAGE. We MUST change this. _There honestly is no time to waste, we must stop DeSantis NOW._** **Think back to some of history's worst tyrants, and imagine what it would've been like if we'd stopped them along the way.** I'm not being hyperbolic, DeSantis is just-as-evil as Trump, yet, luckily for us, possesses the charisma of drying paint. We. Can. Beat. Him. **[So can you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Charlie Crist, so we can stop the totalitarian DeSantis from further destroying Florida, and ever getting his grubby little hands on the United States?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4195e028-c257-468e-b451-159af4f7ca70/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Thank you so much for helping us fight the dictator-in-waiting Desantis. Cliff

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: Why I need to be your next Sec of State
body:
The reality of our current situation is this: Democrats, Independents, Republicans, and even 3rd Party factions all understand that a politicized SoS threatens their liberties, which necessarily threatens state and national survival.
Uniquely positioned in this populist movement, I serve to unify typically opposing parties. These parties are unifying around the common threat of our existing corrupt SoS - an authoritarian posing as a 'liberal'.
**All political parties unite around ease of voting while not sacrificing ballot security. Unsecured voting systems increase the probability of corrupted ballots being injected into the system, negating your lawful vote.**
To make sure your vote is not diluted by corrupt ballots, a balance must be maintained that does not compromise ease of voting and verifiably secure elections - which we do not have today.
There are very well-meaning people who focus ONLY on the ballot access issue but ignore the requirement to verifiably secure elections as required to make sure your vote is not diluted or nullified. The existing SoS deceitfully claims she has 'done audits' and 'engaged in other measures securing systems', while knowing you may not have access to verifying her claims are true. In fact, her claims are not true, and your vote is diluted by the corruption she, loyal to authoritarian extremist ideologies, preserves. Her radical ideologies are demonstrated by her actions, including her relationships with those who installed her in office, proving beyond any doubt that she is no 'liberal' but is an authoritarian posing as a liberal.
Sadly, many of the organizations that advocate for ballot access but oppose other security requirements are actually bad actors attempting to take away your voting rights and create exploits in the voting system they can control. That's why voting access and security go hand-in-hand, as matters of state and national security and survival.
Staff must be properly trained. Each municipality must have a sufficient number of workers and challengers, who must represent a balance of all political parties. Information on how to register to vote must be made readily available to the public. Those not able to vote on election day must receive mail-in ballots that are securely delivered or are transported to polling places free of charge. This is required to avoid ballot-harvesters diluting your vote.
We must ensure that our ballots experience chain-of-custody so your vote is not diluted or functionally negated.
Tallies from local precincts must be properly recorded and securely transferred to the municipality, and results from each municipality must be securely transferred and properly recorded to the county, and the county results must be securely transferred to the state - occurring with verifiably secured chain of custody!
Most importantly, our qualified voter file/database (QVF) must be maintained such that illegal ballot applications are not generated, manipulated, then injected into the voting system to dilute or negate your vote.
And we do need laws requiring voter ID. If any unreasonable barrier exists that prevents a person from obtaining personal identification, SoS assistance must be provided at no charge.
These are just some of the things required to secure your vote from dilution or being negated by corrupted ballots.
Elections are the hallmark of our liberty irrespective of worldview, political party or personal preferences. This being true, you can be assured that irrespective of my worldview and preferences, your voting rights and vote shall be secured.
And most important, unlike our existing SoS, my worldview and related preferences will not result in the politicizing of the SoS office to advance an extremist agenda. Because, unlike the existing corrupt SoS, 'the end does not justify the means' for me.
Your vote for me will ensure SoS systems operate within the rule of law, even if that results in my preferred candidates NOT being elected!
Our Declaration of Independence states, "That governments are instituted among men, deriving their just powers from the consent (vote) of the governed (you)."
As your servant-leader SoS, I will protect your "consent" (vote). Because uncorrupted voting systems are a prerequisite for true equal opportunity for all, irrespective of race, religion, worldview or personal preferences.
Respectfully,
Kristina Karamo
Candidate for Michigan Secretary of State

body:
Tim Walz cannot keep leading MN | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen/test-scores?e=33b11688c1)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

Tim Walz is trying to pump millions of dollars into this election to distract from his failures as governor. **Crime is out of control** ; _in fact_ , for the first time in our state's history, [our crime rate is higher than the national average](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=6ca6e06999&e=33b11688c1). **Our small business climate and economy are not competitive** ; _in fact_ , we're [r](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=bcf083f4a8&e=33b11688c1)[anked 46th out of 50 states for our economic outlook](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=c41b0e2d99&e=33b11688c1) because of Walz's policies.

**And now we come to find that our students are falling behind dramatically;** because of Tim Walz's lockdown distance learning policies and his disregard for funding STUDENTS (not systems), our [kids have suffered greatly and test scores are down](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=c2fe4e5f11&e=33b11688c1)!
* Less than half of Minnesota students are proficient in math and 51% are proficient in reading
* The portion of students proficient in math decreased 10% compared to before the lockdowns
* Just 41% of Minnesota students are proficient in science, down from 51% in 2019
* Just 31% of Black and Hispanic students are proficient in reading. Minnesota remains one of the worst states for racial disparities in education. **Our Black and Hispanic students deserve better!**

None of this is acceptable, and Tim Walz wants to make sure these statistics don't see the light of day - because they are just another factor voters will have to weigh on election day. We keep throwing money at the problem!

**My running mate Matt Birk said it best at the State Fair:**
---
| [ ](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=a17a276d68&e=33b11688c1)
---
| We won't fix this problem by doing the same thing over and over again. Tim Walz and far-left DFL policies are hindering our kids - and Walz continues to insist money is going to fix it! NO - we need structural change.

Next week, we'll be releasing our campaign's education plan for Minnesota! We need to center education around our students again.

Let's tell Tim Walz to FOCUS ON THE ISSUES THAT MATTER!

---
|
In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - MN

subject: ME CD-1 Candidate Ed Thelander Statement on Kabul Bombing Anniversary - "Remember Their Names"
body:
The administration and its backers in Congress would have us forget. Please remember their names, and on the anniversary of their killing, say them: | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/thelanderforcongress/statement-kabul-bombing-anniversary?e=f8a0a76a2b)
---
[](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=38fbf021ba&e=f8a0a76a2b)
**ME CD-1 Candidate Ed Thelander Statement on One-Year Anniversary of Kabul Bombing**
**Remember Their Names** -by Ed ThelanderThere is no shortage of things about the Biden administration that are disappointing, but for those of us who wore the uniform of the United States in Afghanistan, the feckless and shameful pullout a year ago stands alone as the most massive case of dereliction of duty I’ve seen in my lifetime. The thirteen fatalities we incurred as a result of the botched withdrawal aren’t the blip on the radar screen this administration and its backers in Congress consider them to be. No, it is our duty to remember their names, and on the anniversary of their killing to say them:Marine Corps Lance Cpl. David Espinoza; Marine Corps Sgt. Nicole Gee; Marine Corps Staff Sgt. Darin Taylor Hoover; Army Staff Sgt. Ryan Knauss; Marine Corps Cpl. Hunter Lopez; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Dylan R. Merola; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Kareem Nikoui; Marine Corps Cpl. Daegan William-Tyeler Page; Marine Corps Sgt. Johanny Rosario; Marine Corps Cpl. Humberto Sanchez; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Jared Schmitz, and Navy Hospital Corpsman Max Soviak.Earlier this summer, we were fortunate to kill Al Qaeda leader Ayman al-Zawahiri who was allegedly being housed and protected by the Taliban. Think about that: the Taliban who sheltered Zawahiri and Osama bin Laden as they planned and carried out the attacks on the United States on 9/11 have already broken their promise not to harbor enemies of the United States. They never intended to honor any deal with the Biden administration, and now they are spitting in America’s face.Make no mistake, there had to be an end to the war in Afghanistan for NATO and the United States. But given all that we sacrificed for more than 20 years, friends and co-combatants of mine whom we lost, hundreds of billions of dollars, and our national honor – not just as relates to the people of Afghanistan whom we returned to slavery – but to the world. The message the Biden administration sent was America does NOT stand by our friends and allies.When one wonders why Vladimir Putin felt emboldened to invade Ukraine earlier this year or why the Peoples’ Republic of China is rattling it’s sabers over Taiwan, it is impossible not to consider the signal sent by our disastrous withdrawal in which we left not only our Afghan allies high and dry but also abandoned more than $80 billion of advanced weaponry on the battlefield for the Taliban to use against their own people and anyone who stands up to their rapacious, medieval ways in the future.But now all we can do is demand answers. Why was our departure so poorly planned and executed? Why did we not even leave an embassy behind? What real guarantees do we have that a proven enemy of the United States will not strike us again? And for the sake of the brothers we lost in the mountains and valleys of that distant country, what have we learned to make us better warfighters? Where is the after-action report?First District Congresswoman Chellie Pingree has done nothing to demand any accountability over the last year. There should be a thorough, on-going review like we saw after 9/11, but instead there are just crickets. In fact, she has publicly commended the administration for its pullout, which is consistent with the fact that she – like Biden – never supported the war. From her standpoint, men and women who served in the military are not really her people anyway, so why bother?The only American who has faced any consequence is Stuart Scheller, a Marine lieutenant corporal who was court-martialed for criticizing his command’s handling of the retreat. That, like the fact Zawihiri was enjoying freedom and protection in the new Taliban-controlled Afghanistan, tells us everything we need to know.America deserves better. That is why I am running to retire Chellie Pingree and replace her with an active voice that demands accountability for all of us. I have served in combat and spent my career as a US Navy SEAL; I am trained to look for solutions. This month marks a painful anniversary for many Americans. We left friends behind, and the gains for which we fought were simply traded away. They think we’ll just forget, but I will never forget, and neither should you.Maine’s First District needs a real fighter. We need someone who will hold the powerful accountable, and not just hold their water. Responsibility is about finishing the job right, regardless of whether it’s popular or politically correct. Congress has not been responsible and is more focused on the spot lights than getting the answers the American people demand.Please join me in sending a powerful message to Washington this November. We haven’t forgotten, and we are committed to making sure no U.S. serviceman died in vain. Getting there requires all of us to step forward and be the change that will force Congress to finally do its job.– _Ed Thelander, Republican candidate for Maine’s 1st Congressional District, is a 21-veteran of the Navy SEAL Teams and resides in Bristol, where he is an active volunteer in his community._ Contact: [mike@thelanderforcongress.com](mailto:mike@thelanderforcongress.com)

Please remember their names, and on the anniversary of their killing, say them: | | | ME CD-1 Candidate Ed Thelander Statement on One-Year Anniversary of Kabul Bombing Remember Their Names -by Ed ThelanderThere is no shortage of things about the Biden administration that are disappointing, but for those of us who wore the uniform of the United States in Afghanistan, the feckless and shameful pullout a year ago stands alone as the most massive case of dereliction of duty I’ve seen in my lifetime. The thirteen fatalities we incurred as a result of the botched withdrawal aren’t the blip on the radar screen this administration and its backers in Congress consider them to be. No, it is our duty to remember their names, and on the anniversary of their killing to say them:Marine Corps Lance Cpl. David Espinoza; Marine Corps Sgt. Nicole Gee; Marine Corps Staff Sgt. Darin Taylor Hoover; Army Staff Sgt. Ryan Knauss; Marine Corps Cpl. Hunter Lopez; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Dylan R. Merola; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Kareem Nikoui; Marine Corps Cpl. Daegan William-Tyeler Page; Marine Corps Sgt. Johanny Rosario; Marine Corps Cpl. Humberto Sanchez; Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Jared Schmitz, and Navy Hospital Corpsman Max Soviak.Earlier this summer, we were fortunate to kill Al Qaeda leader Ayman al-Zawahiri who was allegedly being housed and protected by the Taliban. Think about that: the Taliban who sheltered Zawahiri and Osama bin Laden as they planned and carried out the attacks on the United States on 9/11 have already broken their promise not to harbor enemies of the United States. They never intended to honor any deal with the Biden administration, and now they are spitting in America’s face.Make no mistake, there had to be an end to the war in Afghanistan for NATO and the United States. But given all that we sacrificed for more than 20 years, friends and co-combatants of mine whom we lost, hundreds of billions of dollars, and our national honor – not just as relates to the people of Afghanistan whom we returned to slavery – but to the world. The message the Biden administration sent was America does NOT stand by our friends and allies.When one wonders why Vladimir Putin felt emboldened to invade Ukraine earlier this year or why the Peoples’ Republic of China is rattling it’s sabers over Taiwan, it is impossible not to consider the signal sent by our disastrous withdrawal in which we left not only our Afghan allies high and dry but also abandoned more than $80 billion of advanced weaponry on the battlefield for the Taliban to use against their own people and anyone who stands up to their rapacious, medieval ways in the future.But now all we can do is demand answers. Why was our departure so poorly planned and executed? Why did we not even leave an embassy behind? What real guarantees do we have that a proven enemy of the United States will not strike us again? And for the sake of the brothers we lost in the mountains and valleys of that distant country, what have we learned to make us better warfighters? Where is the after-action report?First District Congresswoman Chellie Pingree has done nothing to demand any accountability over the last year. There should be a thorough, on-going review like we saw after 9/11, but instead there are just crickets. In fact, she has publicly commended the administration for its pullout, which is consistent with the fact that she – like Biden – never supported the war. From her standpoint, men and women who served in the military are not really her people anyway, so why bother?The only American who has faced any consequence is Stuart Scheller, a Marine lieutenant corporal who was court-martialed for criticizing his command’s handling of the retreat. That, like the fact Zawihiri was enjoying freedom and protection in the new Taliban-controlled Afghanistan, tells us everything we need to know.America deserves better. That is why I am running to retire Chellie Pingree and replace her with an active voice that demands accountability for all of us. I have served in combat and spent my career as a US Navy SEAL; I am trained to look for solutions. This month marks a painful anniversary for many Americans. We left friends behind, and the gains for which we fought were simply traded away. They think we’ll just forget, but I will never forget, and neither should you.Maine’s First District needs a real fighter. We need someone who will hold the powerful accountable, and not just hold their water. Responsibility is about finishing the job right, regardless of whether it’s popular or politically correct. Congress has not been responsible and is more focused on the spot lights than getting the answers the American people demand.Please join me in sending a powerful message to Washington this November. We haven’t forgotten, and we are committed to making sure no U.S. serviceman died in vain. Getting there requires all of us to step forward and be the change that will force Congress to finally do its job.– Ed Thelander, Republican candidate for Maine’s 1st Congressional District, is a 21-veteran of the Navy SEAL Teams and resides in Bristol, where he is an active volunteer in his community. Friend,

It's no secret radicals in our education system are brainwashing young students, especially minority students, to embrace socialism, hate America, and reject the principles of liberty... **but that 's not the worst part.**

Sadly, something far more sinister and evil is unfolding in our public school system...

Before I tell the dark secret about what's happening in classrooms across our country, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation as a nonprofit organization dedicated to reaching urban communities, Black and Hispanic men and women, and young people.

One big caveat - you have to join Friday before midnight.

| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e1f805d1a93e4f9cace732a2ce10f001&_e=UsXT4OSYTSai-Ah0RrA0AgmgDJeu5TUl3uvzBewdJj62eRfAq0UvkTWlFBAE3gvpgyRO4zHx5724XNQsUwEKzz2O7G_k9PjBuvJb06-59mfwm2GtfeYwBOyGvzfq-1HE1-SQxZU0xo9tOQQ59pWt6cvrTEGYrpP4ZdoCtppl_fRfMfnlHZNhDdQTVkrQWhU-6voDOfyw18Xe8QBSMF8cqLUFQiDc7l80iM-4dLU829UadGLL6nzZXfoz1cNjFcSgKyYO8pYMg4BX6P6AAukuzVWglhZYmTwEaoyWUfhXjzSYRq4M6PxdIlOQ1ThnW_Xg)

Fellow Conservative,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e1f805d1a93e4f9cace732a2ce10f001&_e=UsXT4OSYTSai-Ah0RrA0AgmgDJeu5TUl3uvzBewdJj62eRfAq0UvkTWlFBAE3gvpgyRO4zHx5724XNQsUwEKzz2O7G_k9PjBuvJb06-59mfwm2GtfeYwBOyGvzfq-1HE1-SQxZU0xo9tOQQ59pWt6cvrTEGYrpP4ZdoCtppl_fSBreUhBy1AKeQrAqr-WpQoMylP6QzkjbBQ8dF_4QfUuNQYWFHhs3Xm465HMQto3sSG438a0g6GRHFSyCmh_Z0jxnft9VcNnh5u1hHxO90aWUItkakD5c5Rz-Q0e-4N5pMp5tFLZAU_ec_MXWZVwecV)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e1f805d1a93e4f9cace732a2ce10f001&_e=UsXT4OSYTSai-Ah0RrA0AgmgDJeu5TUl3uvzBewdJj62eRfAq0UvkTWlFBAE3gvpgyRO4zHx5724XNQsUwEKzz2O7G_k9PjBuvJb06-59mfwm2GtfeYwBOyGvzfq-1HE1-SQxZU0xo9tOQQ59pWt6cvrTEGYrpP4ZdoCtppl_fQ-IeUoTIXMD0N5t2nNsvGgemQLCfnLrpIZlYljlznaiY98d82zciWEJCIxjCmmndPNbhGY8e0y-YUmKGgaSRoiv_2b9rdlAt7wNBg1Ml5TjUwCowXgbJ3kxUHSsyBWOAxVkY1rJwH1d7VHuLA_64EE)

Friend -

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoeoj6q8i1j924eg6b91bmf21t04v9gkubmhomdg_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

****[****](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlofkkgcbd0ean27vs1v0j7ti98osce42hdss3fo_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)
[**CONTRIBUTION OF $10**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zufdgkpookij6kceeb2t9i4a3fgq5sqagjqi2udg_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $20**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1i63u500b8onjtf6lqpbao7nkq0a6u2garl4n4g_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $50**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeojtamakajlib5tksvfglp22b5grv2g5fdubie0_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $100**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z70bvs987mapkeciqi9ug9i16i16s5mnjc1df6oo_rp22sh2s8i66or4clj66or3cph2bs)

Look, I'm not a politician. I'm nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. So, I'm opening my heart to you today in hopes you'll stand with me.

I won't give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That's not me. But I'll give you my word as a veteran that I'll fight with all I have to do what's right and make you proud.

Thank you & God bless.

**Pat Harrigan**
GOP Conservative Candidate
North Carolina's 14th District

subject: Have you made your voting plan?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Pennsylvania Project
body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter]
Good afternoon, ! With just under 60 days until the voter registration deadline on October 24th, it’s more important than ever to check in with friends, family and loved ones to make sure you have a voting plan. With voting rights, abortion access, education funding, and so much more at stake, we can’t waste any time.
Take 5 minutes to check your voter registration status
Make A Plan to Vote [https://vote.pa/plan/?org=npp]
IMPORTANT DATES TO REMEMBER
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive voted mail-in and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
To register to vote, check your registration status, or to make a voting plan, visit vote.pa [https://vote.pa/?org=npp] .
Demstock 2022: August 26-28
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/795468326239626533476C43635A34734C66687074326C6C6C31685977534F6C55712F703764376C3851624D34714975756F577341794B6F3762784354634A71/editor_images/Demstock.png]
Did you know that it’s Demstock weekend in the Commonwealth? Demstock is the biggest rural Democratic festival in the country taking place from Friday, August 26 through Sunday, August 28 in Franklin, PA
Much like your local county fair, Demstock is filled with fun social events and activities, with opportunities to network with advocates from groups on the front lines fighting for the issues we care about the most. Special guests at this year’s event include: U.S. Senator Bob Casey, Lt. Governor John Fetterman, Attorney General Josh Shapiro, and many more.
This Saturday, NPP will be at Demstock tabling and supporting #RuralPA.
Want to join? Buy tickets today by going to www.Demstock.net [http://www.Demstock.net] and clicking the "Buy Tickets" button!
Take Action
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/220501%20Team%20NPP.jpg]
Did you know you can Volunteer with Team NPP Every Saturday until Election Day? For more information on volunteer opportunities in your region, please contact Enid Santiago at enid@newpaproject.org [enid@newpaproject.org]
VOLUNTEER WITH US [https://secure.everyaction.com/f1NXSOku_Um7UO_341fCxQ2]
We're Registering Voters 365/24/7
We are empowering communities of color, immigrant communities and the youth to use their voice and vote their values. Will you join us and donate to fund the work we are doing across the Commonwealth and defend our democracy?

body:
I’m opening my heart to you today in hopes you’ll stand with me. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6996%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=EZwpFAcoi%2f8ugPymiTqbQg&sysid=1)
I’m opening my heart to you today in hopes you’ll stand with me.
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74609%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yyID58gWoA8yhJQo0mzN2Q&sysid=1)

Friend -

This is the first and last email I’ll ever send you.

You see, I’m a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don’t know me, but I’m a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I’m the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I’m also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That’s why I’m humbly asking if you’ll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74600%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9VWRwT1JLLgju7Yp2dAZDQ&sysid=1)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can’t win this race. But I bet you’ve heard that one before...

I’m not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won’t stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

****[****](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74601%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VWPeBX8KlWiadx27DzEROQ&sysid=1)
[**CONTRIBUTION OF $10**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74602%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nhpfPfgflexOZQhNTCNhvg&sysid=1)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $20**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74603%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xnryK33LS9m0FaqW%2blAABQ&sysid=1)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $50**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74604%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ptWCNVsIMlkhq3EjFLGJ1Q&sysid=1)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $100**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74615%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DIiAclTIGq7VCud%2fFp0icg&sysid=1)

Look, I’m not a politician. I’m nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. So, I’m opening my heart to you today in hopes you’ll stand with me.

I won’t give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That’s not me. But I’ll give you my word as a veteran that I’ll fight with all I have to do what’s right and make you proud.

Thank you & God bless.

**Pat Harrigan**
GOP Conservative Candidate
North Carolina’s 14th District

Derek,
For months we’ve been saying that Dr Oz is a New Jersey resident.
But the truth is that we were wrong.
**Turns out Dr. Oz actually lives in New Jersey... AND Florida!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220826-1?refcode=em20220826-6984&refcode2=6984_434096_tvURWm&akid=6984%2E434096%2EtvURWm)
Palm Beach, FL, to be exact. 😎
Here’s a birds eye view of Dr. Oz’s sprawling $52 million beachfront mansion called “Louwana,” which is a few blocks away from his buddy Donald Trump’s Mar-A-Lago estate.
It’s just ONE of Dr. Oz’s 10 homes. And after making millions of dollars worth of renovations, he even took a shady tax cut.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220826-1?refcode=em20220826-6984&refcode2=6984_434096_tvURWm&akid=6984%2E434096%2EtvURWm)

I mean, can you think of anything more insulting to Pennsylvania voters than this guy? Seriously, Derek. I ACTUALLY LIVE IN PA!!!

❤️ John

body:
Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. |
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5281424765f64f5ba5e23dad3ed98f6a&_e=FXd-EpA6AUtTbaILZkETskk-SuIg7yIOtaHdjy2xVgQ1cAedXEjzrYXCJhi4iibR0F4Tn0c4yAawNwWCLtIQ2woDo1PEE1PFLSHEWM8sX2Q7sEHjRH1gyAXPkWlrO-uQs6t_mAYAMn47WioooRk_3_TkMh8-7w6wHomTFotxkRHU5gCYRivjx8nuo7ODgQ3cBiBYI-ex_tW03KxT4lHE0ZVQSwXoay3WzI4izb8ye8XngnOQE7T_IPnJ4-de_jy2gxTqk_u3b763ItL8-9un0EN0Hm5E1fDLv5RmGMdu_xkGf_cdq1QpKiTDfwMoy_lmB4p8ICQvqrLBl7kPNSzKptEg0b4FiS9y0lCyT12LG8eWlA3t0TeWfeJ0D7nkBJEn2lLdV4sk1Du1UD_atHPEo8gDYBS43jOsxwQBTGppUNyMqflhwuyFW2IBBD7OqoDJ)

---
Fellow American,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5281424765f64f5ba5e23dad3ed98f6a&_e=FXd-EpA6AUtTbaILZkETskk-SuIg7yIOtaHdjy2xVgQ1cAedXEjzrYXCJhi4iibR0F4Tn0c4yAawNwWCLtIQ2woDo1PEE1PFLSHEWM8sX2Q7sEHjRH1gyAXPkWlrO-uQs6t_mAYAMn47WioooRk_3_TkMh8-7w6wHomTFotxkRHU5gCYRivjx8nuo7ODgQ3cBiBYI-ex_tW03KxT4lHE0ZVQSwXoay3WzI4izb8ye8XngnOQE7T_IPnJ4-de_jy2gxTqk_u3b763ItL8-9un0EN0Hm5E1fDLv5RmGMdu_xknx3CTCv5MDG5PgmwxcVeeoadNa7O6ZZIRKetALQJR-uckrMnVWyPzRU2zcb8P6E254Hu9vL6Tse_YfAkIVwK_pLIyDA8dovMkj98uYkTD_4huRr2X-qv5uxSgCSiMxSu2el4oTNE7lK1p6yzae6ol)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **"The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5281424765f64f5ba5e23dad3ed98f6a&_e=FXd-EpA6AUtTbaILZkETskk-SuIg7yIOtaHdjy2xVgQ1cAedXEjzrYXCJhi4iibR0F4Tn0c4yAawNwWCLtIQ2woDo1PEE1PFLSHEWM8sX2Q7sEHjRH1gyAXPkWlrO-uQs6t_mAYAMn47WioooRk_3_TkMh8-7w6wHomTFotxkRHU5gCYRivjx8nuo7ODgQ3cBiBYI-ex_tW03KxT4lHE0ZVQSwXoay3WzI4izb8ye8XngnOQE7T_IPnJ4-de_jy2gxTqk_u3b763ItL8-9un0EN0Hm5E1fDLv5RmGMdu_xl3yTTXqYGGmHjCjQcs5eklme3IPGNU6ITfv5h2oOW8sCMGr9rap6AP5rXNh77EcvFMbZ7D0QFbK1qZvY8CKIFxpxUs9j2xSHklmXGuZwV4uwDhFegTPnu0Tcwan3wk4hUcRH8dDm5it2YDEjU_sSxv)

It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. Hi team,

Right now, we’re kicking off our fundraising for our FINAL August push. And what that means is simple: we’ve got two more months to give this EVERYTHING we’ve got. So team, I’m asking for your help — to hold New Jersey’s 7th Congressional district and to protect our democracy and freedoms for generations to come.

In the last two months alone, our Democratic majority has delivered on a HUGE set of commitments to New Jerseyans and to America:** lowering prescription costs for seniors, getting veterans the healthcare they’ve earned, the biggest investment in history in fighting climate change, and the first gun violence prevention bill in decades — all while reducing the deficit and making big corporations pay taxes for a change.

| | **Happy Women’s Equality Day, friends!** In honor of the 102nd anniversary of women’s suffrage, I wanted to share a personal note about **why we need more women representing our communities in office.** I’ve worked in the political landscape for decades, and much of my early work as a community organizer took place in groups of mostly women. **Our experiences as women and mothers propelled us to mobilize on issues that touch all of our lives** , regardless of political affiliation, like education and women’s health. Now, as the only woman running for Congress in our district and the only woman in my class in the Legislature, I can proudly attest to the value of women’s voices in government — and the _unstoppable_ power we can create when we work together. **[I’m running for Congress to continue my life’s work for women and families. I want my daughter and sons to see a woman representing our district for the very first time — and with your help, we will make it happen. This election season has heated up fast, and I wanted to touch base with my team.

As campaigning gets busier and I meet more patriots, **I wanted to make sure every one of my team members knows the story of WHY I decided to run for Congress.**

I’m a North Carolina native, but I’ve lived across the globe during my service with the Green Berets. I’ve been to every corner of the world and I can tell you: nothing comes _close_ to living in the United States of America.

I dedicated my life to serving our country and our people. When I came home from the war in Afghanistan, I began an arms business out of a double-wide trailer with my incredible wife, Rocky. From our trailer home, we moved on to build a one-of-a-kind arms manufacturing business right here in North Carolina.

I built an amazing family and business with Rocky but I became deeply disturbed by our so-called leaders and the radical policies that affected our lives.

After the tyrannical shutdowns of 2020 and the disgraceful pull out of Afghanistan in 2021, I saw our country’s greatness come into question.

Now, America’s greatest threats lie within our borders. Anti-God, anti-American foes have made their way to Washington and will take down our country if we let them.

Fellow American, my call of duty has remained the same since I swore loyalty to the U.S. at West Point. I might have retired my uniform, Friend. But I’m not done fighting for this nation, and if you’re not either I hope you’ll join me.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95767/images/JF%20email%20banner.png]
Hi Peter,
Today is Women’s Equality Day, which commemorates the day in 1920 when U.S. women were first granted the right to vote. However, laws still existed then that excluded Native American, Black, Asian and Latina women from voting.
This day reminds us to keep working to fight existing inequities. In Rhode Island, women earn 83 cents for every dollar men earn. Women make up more than half of our country’s population, and yet only 30% of the House of Representatives. And we have certainly seen with the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade that there is still so much work to do for women’s rights and reproductive justice.
In Congress, among my priorities to level the playing field are:
Protecting choice by fighting to codify Roe v. Wade.
Investing in all of our moms by working to pass the Black Maternal Health “Momnibus” Act [https://www.congress.gov/bill/117th-congress/house-bill/959] , which addresses the racial and ethnic inequities in maternal health.
Ensuring equal pay bysupporting the Paycheck Fairness Act to close the gap in earnings between women and men.
Supporting our families by advocating for permanent paid family leave , which has been proven to work for employers and families.
We are a better country when half of us are on the same footing as the other. I ask that you donate $19.20 to my campaign [https://joyfoxcongress.com/donate-to-joy-fox-for-congress/] so we can elect the FIRST Democratic woman to Congress from Rhode Island - a women with deep roots in this district and the ability to get things done for you
Thank you,
Joy

clean_body: [] Hi Peter, Today is Women’s Equality Day, which commemorates the day in 1920 when U.S. women were first granted the right to vote. However, laws still existed then that excluded Native American, Black, Asian and Latina women from voting. This day reminds us to keep working to fight existing inequities. In Rhode Island, women earn 83 cents for every dollar men earn. Women make up more than half of our country’s population, and yet only 30% of the House of Representatives. And we have certainly seen with the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade that there is still so much work to do for women’s rights and reproductive justice. In Congress, among my priorities to level the playing field are: Protecting choice by fighting to codify Roe v. Wade. Investing in all of our moms by working to pass the Black Maternal Health “Momnibus” Act [] , which addresses the racial and ethnic inequities in maternal health. Ensuring equal pay bysupporting the Paycheck Fairness Act to close the gap in earnings between women and men. Supporting our families by advocating for permanent paid family leave , which has been proven to work for employers and families. We are a better country when half of us are on the same footing as the other. body:
