Derek —

The American people understand the grave threat our country faces if the
Republican Party retakes either chamber of Congress 74 days from now.

According to a recent NBC News poll, "threats to democracy" is now the top
issue in the country for voters come November. Check it out:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220826_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=767%2E5257348%2EDqZgVL ]The Hill article headline titled 'Threats to democracy top list of issues
facing US: poll'

The GOP and Donald Trump came dangerously close to overturning the will of
the people when it was time to certify the results of the 2020 election.
147 Republican members of Congress embraced Trump’s Big Lie and voted to
overturn the results of the election. And their dangerous lies have not
stopped – to this day.

For years, I have worked to hold Donald Trump and the GOP accountable for
their attacks on our democracy and to tell the American people the truth.
That work continues, but in order to protect the right to vote, improve
oversight, prevent abuses of power, and combat dangerous misinformation,
we cannot allow Republicans to retake control of Congress. We just can’t.

The American people understand the grave crisis this country faces. The
vast majority know that we need to hold Trump and his cronies accountable
for their attacks on our democracy in order to preserve and protect our
freedoms.

But protecting our system of government is no easy task in the face of the
most expensive midterm campaign our country has ever seen. We need lots of
resources to take our message to the public and combat the persistent
attacks from Donald Trump and his fellow MAGA Republicans with their
multimillion-dollar advertising blitzes. Your support helps us reach
voters and hold the GOP accountable for their election lies — and stop
more of them from being elected into office.

Friend -

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvamudnmpvbh54b43usmh300hnh8kueue78hd620_rp22sh2s8i66or4clgm0ob6clh2bs)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

****[****](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1edbe902c49anbaolno6rfeoehp4a126fel32d0_rp22sh2s8i66or4clgm0ob6clh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $20**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3r6hpr51a76jq6q9d36ro1j48gav3v35e53fv4o_rp22sh2s8i66or4clgm0ob6clh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $50**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zl4086epfsrmea2j8p6s73lfq7q3ffoqa47mmvh0_rp22sh2s8i66or4clgm0ob6clh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $100**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zajl86gmvpp1gfhjpbdp23rpd17f4p5q79v8vi9g_rp22sh2s8i66or4clgm0ob6clh2bs)

Look, I'm not a politician. I'm nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. So, I'm opening my heart to you today in hopes you'll stand with me.

I won't give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That's not me. But I'll give you my word as a veteran that I'll fight with all I have to do what's right and make you proud.

Thank you & God bless.

**Pat Harrigan**
GOP Conservative Candidate
North Carolina's 14th District

Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. |
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=4a742f3cef0040538247d4377abea0e6&_e=l526UEnVxE5LLIH5GZIB1bDxHpN-0qecdbZ4mbjzFgco6yuGFb_bmK65FHNiPHt5I8nJ4yvYn92SF_rJXmQobyD5sNURMjmvC-tQoRCTvwVz0OO3SXnSJvsgei1vnFvPSVhJKO5GXlJ3qfrnIFyqKteky69UFxEpVqTCCcramCxnWE4od64Rx0tEUiIALn-uOok-JeN_FvN6kG7xDnjW7Mcny4_0AHufTrO-6ppgeqAE3z5kspRTArGkv40KJ2QwE1V1UhhdPRBCLHtjl4U1MOkU9tGBWcNtJe4zsm__vsyjFxvUl9lpzEz6t_Irpc8_4l57KVDnGLUKSBGYD0NNLwl9wvd1m46k8OpOu1kChlbRF8kjY72SmpvYSRzfOkdA57tEEfW5TRqYGvsKUWYwGux0HAuXA8WUoNNURNPTwqQql4--5VStnjZJMQlKzgT4)

---
Fellow American,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. A peek at the Inflation Reduction Act’s climate investments and President Joe Biden’s recent remarks! | | |
---
Happy Friday, Peter! Over the past few weeks, you’ve read all about the _Inflation Reduction Act,_ recently signed into law by President Biden. This legislation makes historic investments in climate and proves that Democrats are siding with the American people while Republicans side with special interests. And just yesterday, during President Biden’s speech in Maryland, he made the case for why we need folks out and energized to vote for Democrats this November. **Read on to learn more about POTUS’s recent speech, as well as the climate investments made possible thanks to committed Democrats like you →**

* * *
**Climate and the _Inflation Reduction Act_** When President Biden took office, he promised to combat the climate crisis. And that’s exactly what the _Inflation Reduction Act_ is doing. Not only does it lower costs, but it is also the most aggressive action the U.S. has taken to address the climate crisis. Just take a look: 🌎**Reducing Pollution:** This law puts us in place to cut climate pollution in half by 2030 and reach net-zero emissions by 2050. 🌎**Cutting Energy Costs:** The costs of energy-efficient appliances, home improvements, and more will be lower with this legislation, saving families an average of $500 a year on energy bills. 🌎**Creating Good-Paying Jobs:** With the initiatives to produce a cleaner and greener climate, this legislation will create millions of good-paying jobs making clean energy right here in America.

clean_body: A peek at the Inflation Reduction Act’s climate investments and President Joe Biden’s recent remarks! | | | Happy Friday, Peter! Over the past few weeks, you’ve read all about the Inflation Reduction Act, recently signed into law by President Biden. This legislation makes historic investments in climate and proves that Democrats are siding with the American people while Republicans side with special interests. And just yesterday, during President Biden’s speech in Maryland, he made the case for why we need folks out and energized to vote for Democrats this November. Read on to learn more about POTUS’s recent speech, as well as the climate investments made possible thanks to committed Democrats like you → Climate and the Inflation Reduction Act When President Biden took office, he promised to combat the climate crisis. And that’s exactly what the Inflation Reduction Act is doing. Not only does it lower costs, but it is also the most aggressive action the U.S. has taken to address the climate crisis. Just take a look: 🌎Reducing Pollution: This law puts us in place to cut climate pollution in half by 2030 and reach net-zero emissions by 2050. 🌎Cutting Energy Costs: The costs of energy-efficient appliances, home improvements, and more will be lower with this legislation, saving families an average of $500 a year on energy bills. 🌎Creating Good-Paying Jobs: With the initiatives to produce a cleaner and greener climate, this legislation will create millions of good-paying jobs making clean energy right here in America. | | | President Biden on the midterms and how you can help → In case you missed it, President Biden spoke at a rally in Maryland last night on the importance of the upcoming midterms and why we must do everything in our power to elect Democrats up and down the ballot this November. To get involved, sign up to join our call crew Dial-A-Thon this Saturday, 8/27. | | [NEW MERCH ALERT] Democrats did that: With all our successes over the past few months, we’re celebrating our incredibly important wins with a limited-edition tote bag! Carry around this tote to spread awareness for recent Democratic wins like the Inflation Reduction Act, the CHIPS and Science Act, and the PACT Act. | | You heard President Biden, Peter: President Biden said it loud and clear: "Your right to choose is on the ballot. Your right to privacy is on the ballot. Your Social Security -- that you’ve paid into your whole life, your Medicare, your health care. The safety of your kids in school from gun violence. Your right to breathe clean air and drink clean water -- and the survival of our very planet. Your right to vote and to have that vote counted fairly. Our very democracy is on the ballot. " There is too much at risk not to get involved now. We’ve got to do all we can to ensure that Democrats are successful this November in all communities, at all levels of government. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49784690/363471296/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzUxY2M4My01OTI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DPADNnYl3GRJJs16ndUqxTNrze-CtZisbA1HPWFsSGQ=)

Team,
This week, I accepted an invitation from Nexstar media group to debate Governor DeWine – because Ohioans deserve the chance to hear directly from us on the issues.
An open exchange of ideas would give Ohioans the chance to look at our records, our positions, and our plans for our state and decide which vision they prefer.
But more than a month after I challenged Governor DeWine to a series of debates all over the state, he and his team are still doing everything they can to stall and evade.
**[I’m ready to debate Governor DeWine – but he’s _still_ not committing. If you’re ready to help me hold him accountable this fall, chip in $5 to my campaign right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49784691/363471297/-1465347296?refcode=nw_em_220826_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzUxY2M4My01OTI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DPADNnYl3GRJJs16ndUqxTNrze-CtZisbA1HPWFsSGQ=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49784692/363471298/-1465347296?refcode=nw_em_220826_1_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzUxY2M4My01OTI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DPADNnYl3GRJJs16ndUqxTNrze-CtZisbA1HPWFsSGQ=)

**Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire.**
This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority — it's bad for our democracy.
Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024."

body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e63ed48b6231a15449b45e1e7fe57c3a1860f252af0758df46b7b4830cdd98300616719487960b7d759f28971ea20f644ccf73f6cf9bdd8673fea50fb5bfe279e125988b46fe78b8a4fa170876d8f558

Peter,

Time and time again, we’ve seen the Left place woke ideologies over data and evidence.

For too long, the Democrat stratagem has been to declare something as fact, be wrong about said “fact,” and then move the goalpost further down the field.

They don’t do this because they are “following the science” or any data-backed evidence. They do it because they will stop at nothing to command complete and total control from the American people.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f2c0316e9a46319b21b3a2d014d50dbf3fd455e5aed8eda46f7abdf52bd3d88e8b802d893fe640c4663a4675b098c6635537fdc67f4d46e0d15ba94d0c685f3c
>>">Help us fight back against power-hungry Democrats looking to control your every move >>>

The Left has a different set of rules than the ones they impose on the rest of us. Their lockdowns, force-masking of children, and orders to choose between a job they need and a jab they don’t want did not apply to themselves, their children, or their families.

While these draconian rules were ruining people’s lives, Nancy Pelosi was getting her hair done in a salon she made sure was shut down for everyone else. Gavin Newsom was dining indoors at restaurants that were otherwise closed to the rest of the population.

They said school closures were necessary to mitigate the spread of COVID, and they were wrong about that. They said we had to force-mask kids when they knew it was wrong but speaking up would go against their narrative.

Prior to COVID, medical associations had material on their websites expressing the importance of facial cues to the development of young children. Once the masking craze hit, they took it all down.

They didn’t take it down because the science suddenly changed. They took it down because they wanted to follow their ideological narrative and they weren’t willing to stand with what’s right.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f2c0316e9a46319b21b3a2d014d50dbf3fd455e5aed8eda46f7abdf52bd3d88e8b802d893fe640c4663a4675b098c6635537fdc67f4d46e0d15ba94d0c685f3c
>>">Pledge your support today to stand with me against the Left’s radical agenda>>>

They were willing to sacrifice the developmental and educational progress of children across the country to stick to their narrative. An entire generation’s futures were simply collateral damage in the quest to advance their ideological agenda.

That’s not right, and it’s certainly not the way we did things in Florida.

As Governor, I’ve said that our state is where woke goes to die and I MEANT it.

In Florida, we’ve taken on woke corporations and battled ideologies head-on because we prioritize people over politics.

We’re not going to let this state descend into some type of woke dumpster fire. In Florida, we’re going to follow common sense, we’re going to follow the facts, and we’re going to keep our state the freest state in the nation.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f2c0316e9a46319b21b3a2d014d50dbf3fd455e5aed8eda46f7abdf52bd3d88e8b802d893fe640c4663a4675b098c6635537fdc67f4d46e0d15ba94d0c685f3c
>>">Are you with me? >>>

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

If you knew that $5 could change the course of political history for a generation, would you make that contribution?

If you knew $5 could guarantee we **hold our Senate majority so we can pass President Biden’s bold agenda, prevent Mitch McConnell from blocking our progress, and keep America on the right track forward** , would you take that leap?

[**Now’s your chance: we’re running behind on our must-hit $250,000 fundraising goal before the public FEC deadline, and we need support from folks like you. Will you donate $5 now to help make up the difference and defend Democrats’ Senate majority?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/8703?t=5&amount=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&code=DPE-FD-20220826-Schumer-Schumer3-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220826-Schumer-Schumer3-Pros-sl1&akid=6187%2E9716520%2EoSJvN-)

Here’s what I mean when I talk about $5: President Biden's critical agenda _hinges_ on our Democratic Senate, and Mitch McConnell only needs ONE seat to regain power. **That’s a single seat preventing McConnell from completely blocking President Biden’s transformative agenda -- and a single seat could be decided by a single vote.**

Democratic champions like Mark Kelly, Maggie Hassan, Raphael Warnock, and Catherine Cortez Masto are all up for re-election this year -- and we’re looking at four _extremely close_ races. _One loss_ could be _devastating._

**I’m not exaggerating when I tell you that $5 from supporters like you could decide our political future.** But right now, we’re still waiting on a contribution from you today, and I know you wouldn’t miss out on a chance like this to be a real difference-maker.

**[If everyone reading this message contributed right now, we’d hit this crucial goal in no time. But as it stands right now, Republicans are threatening to out-raise us AGAIN. We can’t let that happen -- and it all starts with $5. But we’ll never know unless folks across the country band together and pitch in $5 to protect our Senate majority.

I know that $5 doesn’t sound like a lot in the face of the GOP megadonor machine, but think of it this way: **we have strength in numbers, and if we learned anything in 2020, it’s that our numbers are greater -- as long as everyone steps up to do their part.**

| | | | Shocking and Disturbing New Video Exposes Chris Doughty's Company for a Lengthy History of Terrible Air and Noise Pollution
BOSTON, Mass. -- A shocking and disturbing new video released today has exposed Capstan Atlantic, Inc., run by self-funded gubernatorial candidate Chris Doughty, for a lengthy history of environmental pollution in the Wrentham, Massachusetts neighborhood where it's located and poor treatment of the company's neighbors.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mA2kltcqxJxABcat_pVyR_6MDLNAFxKjIjgACU2aP1lF4ELpJgCR9mz6YZoQSUBH0gj4zGf5YIccRveuMb-X8bOD-sFyq1QbMDz40NQOdlSh7av_VgCSC3E6NXN6KdGVrfD0HKOfWdli1v34QPrXhQ==&c=HF_0fA98UigMNmfgIm2ap0_f8ReiTkw0wGpmiYZ6Uj05pNix4WZW7w==&ch=aWSYoXgq2PsO-N8nhM7RltM8_Sprr03XZJzx0sg0VUvcnMguDcg61g==)
---
---
| In the video, Tim and Lynette O'Connell, whose home abuts Doughty's company, detail a long history of air pollution and loud noise produced by the company. The pollution, they claim, is so bad that they have had to wash residue off the side of their home. They also claim the noise is excessive.
The O'Connells claim they brought these issues to the attention of Chris Doughty repeatedly in the past, to no avail. "Nobody cares," they say of Doughty and Capstan's management.
In the video, the O'Connells claim the issue is relevant in the race for Governor, where Chris Doughty is relying on his experience as a CEO for credibility because of his lack of a political record. "How can you trust somebody that can't run their own business to run the state of Massachusetts?" They further admonish Doughty for having wrongfully claimed federal assistance during the pandemic and now using that money to self-fund his gubernatorial campaign, without having addressed pollution issues at the company.
Capstan Atlantic has been the subject of environmental fines in the past, [as reported several months ago in the Sun Chronicle](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mA2kltcqxJxABcat_pVyR_6MDLNAFxKjIjgACU2aP1lF4ELpJgCR9haLUV-0yEcbQrjL_UBcsJ37d-wVTZxGs3cSK6Od4LSXWcwhnG7qNlAP8Qqo-vhjhiJe9wxg8sC72i0-rlirO2-9Geba5378vUI5zBBfErpKMxRB4El-5QEU8sU2uByEqjdwrLSTxcAiWSsnriPsVN-qlvMQAgztjaYzpNiROIzYJ8HNXGyCSv9ZmRAYxCvE-0C4alCBmuerR4Me3gv0JIBxtMeb-9ROFRnp8sKnym432jxF3D2SAfZsvao9e_rcZyvgKJsyMu5eCEmrRSn1DJxzVo77BfbscUMKW-iLnlmP&c=HF_0fA98UigMNmfgIm2ap0_f8ReiTkw0wGpmiYZ6Uj05pNix4WZW7w==&ch=aWSYoXgq2PsO-N8nhM7RltM8_Sprr03XZJzx0sg0VUvcnMguDcg61g==).
"Voters need to know the full story behind the people they're voting for in the Republican Primary on September 6," Amanda Orlando, Campaign Manager for Diehl for MA, said. "We've known all along that Chris Doughty is not a credible Republican on the basis of his 2016 vote for Hillary Clinton for President. Now, this damning video casts overwhelming doubt on Chris Doughty's credibility to lead the state on the basis of being the CEO of a local company." ###

Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76f8d0f2a7284124acf796fcb91050c8&_e=gTp9P_BOe7e3iw2-ztng292RG9t4CKovMRqjCcparnosWo3rbarYg9_MlY0hwMPPBcCKSRUAAqVVNCX_bC9hDzG60IqVWUgBUhRudB0hsNKt5d5MfoWNNcs-orCYwWcd_SRhxY5oQ2BShrOaVNxpKIHY1dL-0TmCGBGCb2I6r2tTrQbbduqzblZGZ7a_8dRyJK9FE7wyre5MXnUtSUEKatlyovrdRFLkv91vDiWpLmuw0XQvh4pOGv5dDK8rc6ausH9cm6rytN-dSIFRN-CK_-KLA-I4pmCgY3XdkDPdD5Uq3ynj8p5ziKF78iq136O4snrkc9dL_Di9ykSOzxNdT4F92AJ5P53dvl7NlYhS6piJuq_bXbOW7Mk0mR-SxK5FhTvvIUkBn_w0CPC2dJUheFxYfuF43FS3lu9W1URBqva1wwNBFpbnOaJ7wjckkx1f)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **"The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76f8d0f2a7284124acf796fcb91050c8&_e=gTp9P_BOe7e3iw2-ztng292RG9t4CKovMRqjCcparnosWo3rbarYg9_MlY0hwMPPBcCKSRUAAqVVNCX_bC9hDzG60IqVWUgBUhRudB0hsNKt5d5MfoWNNcs-orCYwWcd_SRhxY5oQ2BShrOaVNxpKIHY1dL-0TmCGBGCb2I6r2tTrQbbduqzblZGZ7a_8dRyJK9FE7wyre5MXnUtSUEKatlyovrdRFLkv91vDiWpLmuw0XQvh4pOGv5dDK8rc6ausH9cm6rytN-dSIFRN-CK_-KLA-I4pmCgY3XdkDPdD5VKkWzexMa8UPIYTt9odjCh_NDpWpN6ay5mpKUSx_vGZmXmjBEK5vhu3NACV3ok3NtvBu1EOrAXmRZUYgFRfA2yS0Z9PbxR7E5ePMFXR8aYSTN78-M53GDsz9T4iMYeAqkI_pefW6CF0whICbiK1bwg)

It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. But now that I'm running for office, A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me. The ad is titled "The Real Herschel Walker," but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people. Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage. With high gasoline prices, skyrocketing inflation, increasing taxes, and rising crime at the forefront of voters' minds, it's easy to see why my opponents don't want to talk about the issues. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally. The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you. Thanks, Herschel Walker P.S. The topic of mental health is so important to me that I recently wrote an op-ed in the Wall Street Journal with much of the information contained in this email. In spite of the attacks, I will never stop my efforts to help others. | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but ._

body:
| | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49800520/363523112/2097321191?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220826mom_kj_actives_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2Q2MjllYi04MTI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UH2MvEG2vvOeU14ocxiI0QuxlQzmzEUiY-BLTYlXYy8=)

My mom passed away in her sleep earlier this week. It was the end of a four-year journey that started with a surprise stage IV lung cancer diagnosis in April 2018. It was a surprise because she never smoked. Also, for the thirty years that she was a nurse, she not only took very good care of herself but browbeat us and her family to do the same. She got my father to stop smoking. She managed his diabetes. She made me get a colonoscopy before I got married because I one day saw blood when I went to the bathroom and we have a family history of colon cancer. She never missed a medical appointment and did “everything right.” I am sharing below a letter I wrote to her, in her memory, because it was her love for me and her support, and our painful journey in the healthcare system, that inspired me to run for Congress. I want to fight for millions like her because you shouldn’t need a physician and lawyer as a son, who knew how to research clinical trials, knew the right questions to ask and landmines to sidestep, and who wouldn’t take no for an answer, to have a fighting chance. My mom was a fighter. She survived four years of cancer, autoimmune encephalitis, Parkinsonism, and physicians who tried to convince her to withdraw treatment six months in. During that period she got to see her first granddaughter graduate from college. She got to hold her third grandchild in her arms months after he was born. She got to check off her bucket list having breakfast at the Ahwahnee Dining Room in Yosemite Valley. She got to hear my speech announcing my run for Congress, and the last thing I told her before I kissed her during my last visit home a month ago, was that I was going to win this race for her. _**Dear mom,**_ You told me that as you laid in the delivery room at the county hospital the morning I was born, you worried that the physician hadn’t arrived yet after you had been in labor for hours. As you once said, I was coming into the world, whether they were ready or not. When I had to have emergency surgery on my hand at 18 months old, you sewed a glove to protect the bandages on my hand that I wore for months. When I had influenza at ten years old and slept for days sitting up in a chair in the living room, you stayed up all night with me telling me family stories so that I wasn’t alone. As a child, you drilled me on everything from multiplication tables to English grammar and always reminded me of the gift and opportunity that education can bring. **As a child, you inspired me to become a physician when I saw you give a woman CPR and save her life when we were out shopping.** You taught me how to put an IV in when I was 12 years old, using yourself as my patient. And you told me I could go to medical school when you couldn’t. You were a nurse for thirty years who took care of everyone in our neighborhood, even our neighbor Mr. Brown — who helped set up our farm and gave me my first job — when he was dying of colon cancer. You even encouraged me to continue to medical school when my best friend committed suicide when I was twenty years old and blamed myself for his mental health challenges. You once told me that through my journey in medical school and law school, taking the oath of office to become a Naval Officer, and time overseas in India and the Middle East, I was showing you and dad places you never knew existed. _But I wouldn’t have been able to do any of these things if you hadn’t bought used Shakespeare books at yard sales and made them part of my summer reading as a child._ I am who I am because of you. When I was in Iraq you sent me care packages every two weeks. I called you before every flight because I didn’t know if that was the last time I would hear your voice. You welcomed me home when I returned. When you were diagnosed with Stage IV lung cancer, you were already starting to show signs of autoimmune encephalitis but we didn’t realize it. We wondered how could this happen because you didn’t smoke and I realized even as a physician, we don’t focus enough attention on the one in five people who get lung cancer without smoking. That we sometimes focus on the averages rather than the person in front of us, and I was afraid that was going to happen to you. When I brought you out to California to make sure I was involved in your care, read everything about the latest treatments for lung cancer and the five-year-old SEER data, I was angry that the first oncologist said you likely had six months to live without even having reviewed your full record. I was shocked when we were encouraged to withdraw care a month later when you were unexplainably unresponsive in the hospital. But just like you did with us as children, I wouldn’t take no for an answer. We fought, we changed hospitals, and you got the treatment you needed. When I was bringing you back to Michigan six months later and you had no memory of the weeks you spent in the hospital, the brain biopsy for you I had to approve, afraid of the procedure, the weeks I visited you in neuro rehab bringing you extra food to eat, learning how to help you walk, you said to me, “you have done a lot for me.” I teared up in disbelief that you said that because I responded with what I felt, “you would have done the same for me.” Four and a half years later, after surgery, treatment, weight loss, and a recurrence of your encephalitis, you passed away peacefully in your sleep. It’s not the plan we had: you, in your nineties, spending your last days with my family in California. But it was the best we could get. You inspired me to run for Congress, not for myself, but for you, and so many other millions of patients that I know we have the technology and innovation to give a better chance. I am running because the healthcare system you dedicated your life to, I trained in and work in, did not work for you the way it should have. I’m running because you don’t have to be Democrat, Republican or Independent to realize our healthcare system and politicians aren’t working for us – you just have to be human. I’m running because enough is enough and the time is now for us to stop fighting each other and work together for a better chance for all of our families. _**Thank you for helping to be my why and thank you for being the greatest advocate I will ever have.**_ Love, Your son | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49800522/363523113/2097321191?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220826mom_kj_actives_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2Q2MjllYi04MTI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UH2MvEG2vvOeU14ocxiI0QuxlQzmzEUiY-BLTYlXYy8=)

I’m not a millionaire who was born into powerful connections.

**I’m a kid from the Bronx who was raised by a single mother on the minimum wage, so I’ve _lived_ the experiences that many other politicians just talk about.**

I’ve experienced food and housing insecurity.
I’ve faced racism and homophobia firsthand.
People I love have been ensnared by the criminal justice system.

We were given a mandate by the American people in 2020, and it’s _our duty_ to make the most of it.

We have _a duty_ to end child poverty.
We have _a duty_ to create safe housing.
We have _a duty_ to protect our nation’s most vulnerable.

**But Republicans want to take our mandate, Peter -- which is why they’re targeting 47 seats in the House next year.**

So we need to prepare now to protect it.

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49787790/363483215/-1752180686?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWEzYzY0MS02MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C5Kzl8fdDgRcnbDpPOg886hcaN93RcPvLWYLGW2GiSE=)
Peter, One of the best things about campaigning is meeting voters around the 17th District and hearing about the issues on their hearts and minds. Voters are often excited to meet a candidate in-person -- and many openly share their thoughts on some of the most pressing problems facing our communities. **Over the past few weeks, I’ve had a chance to meet everyday Illinoisans across our district, and I wanted to share a few highlights of our conversations. After all, these are the people I’m running to represent.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49787791/363483216/-295409223?refcode=em-8.26.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWEzYzY0MS02MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C5Kzl8fdDgRcnbDpPOg886hcaN93RcPvLWYLGW2GiSE=) **In Normal** , I heard from a gentleman who was excited to live in a swing district so he could help elect a Democrat who would advocate for gun safety measures – he was “terrified” of his kids going to school. **In Freeport** , Beth told me that my weather forecasts had been a “bright spot” in her days for years, and that she was excited to vote for someone who has experience informing the public about matters that affect them directly. **In Galva** , I spoke to a couple who identified as Republicans, and were appreciative that I showed up in their small town to engage face-to-face with voters of all stripes. They were glad I was running because I have a track record of delivering the facts, and they wanted to see “less political nonsense and more following the facts.” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49787792/363483217/-295409223?refcode=em-8.26.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWEzYzY0MS02MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C5Kzl8fdDgRcnbDpPOg886hcaN93RcPvLWYLGW2GiSE=) **I want to thank you for your support so far, Peter.** Traveling the region is a great way to meet voters, but this race will be too close to rely on our ground game alone. We still need to reach people through mail, billboards, radio, digital, and TV advertising. [**If you can, will you chip in $5 to help us communicate with voters in every way possible? Anything you give goes straight to our efforts to reach more undecided voters across IL-17.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49787793/363483218/-295409223?refcode=em-8.26.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWEzYzY0MS02MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C5Kzl8fdDgRcnbDpPOg886hcaN93RcPvLWYLGW2GiSE=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Chip in $10 Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49787794/363483219/-295409223?refcode=em-8.26.22-all-b&express_lane=true&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWEzYzY0MS02MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C5Kzl8fdDgRcnbDpPOg886hcaN93RcPvLWYLGW2GiSE=)

Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=53c179e498cd4cdcb67234d943114b50&_e=kNkYlunvPVKiYDuqWFYIn7aZxhRiPjXkFUySTOIbXoixFr4JpNi3zTG3ZcvPnV-X3Pa_K1Zd5iXjTqHBMwAw49obr__VLY6lwgPyzPLqtz34q4aR8UiLkAhttG2VaqNqFtwiFX4dKGh9ABwBfACjtl3WJlU6HgVUCByFZoYXdKLcFb8d4B2kKBPNSNItA9b1yzra0exa4Uvl-IQJY0sna1yl00EJeBIKwzQCW5Emp6zhquHC5dmQdBDC9BmvhUzQphBKNdmN6-9sVsYj9ohDegE5d5Arro0QN6XRNnoBVSKWOik9PDgVzj_UDcot0fdqiPUdFyN8Dyem59DVquSKHOh72YY02skpxVnTimzamMxWzlrE9lBNA774xmV7LM6DInoOO3mFp7Zdn5nt5QBHtPiqsor5JJbfu8Doo_r8Yzg39DXKE_HwkMNwxJTQD3TH)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

clean_body: Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. | Peter, In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. But now that I'm running for office, A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me. The ad is titled "The Real Herschel Walker," but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people. Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage. With high gasoline prices, skyrocketing inflation, increasing taxes, and rising crime at the forefront of voters' minds, it's easy to see why my opponents don't want to talk about the issues. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally. The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you. Thanks, Herschel Walker P.S. ## My former boss, Reince Priebus on Beyond the Briefing...
This was a fun episode. Reince and I go through his early career, what made him get into party politics after running himself, how we came into the RNC and turned things around (including the ridiculous things we did to save money), the 2016 campaign and of course the Trump White House. This episode is perfect for all the political nerds, especially in the lead up to the midterms.
| [Listen here](https://seanspicer.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d009170fb4604b5974b5521bd&id=3f36a8b12f&e=f6564bbe3b)

| | Dear Fellow American,
Does America need a “Great Reset?”
In 2020, members of the world’s elite met at the World Economic Forum and launched the Great Reset initiative to transform the world economy.
As Klaus Schwab—the founder and executive director of the Forum—wrote, “we need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, this would have the effect of canceling our American way of life.
A recent Hillsdale College seminar considered the idea of the Great Reset, its ramifications for America, and pro-freedom alternatives.

Friend,

Last weekend I stood before the Michigan Democratic Convention and accepted the Michigan Democratic party’s nomination for secretary of state. I believe my candidacy marks an important moment for our democracy and the future of election administration in our state. I shared with the delegates our success in delivering the most safe, secure, and transparent election in Michigan history in 2020. And in the face of a rising tide of election extremism and conspiracy, I am committed to accomplishing the same this November - and again in 2024.

With Election Day just around the corner, I’m going to fight as hard as I have ever fought in these remaining weeks to make sure every Michigander knows the true contrast between myself and my opponent - it’s a choice that will impact the future of democracy in our state and nation. Will you pitch in today to help us do just that?

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=082622]

This weekend my opponent will be formally nominated at the Michigan Republican party’s state convention. She will assuredly accept the nomination while spreading the same election lies that have fueled her campaign and will tap into the dark, anti-democratic impulses of extremists in our state.

But here’s the deal: our pro-truth, pro-democracy coalition is stronger than those peddling or believing lies and conspiracies. Between now and November 8th (that’s 74 days from today!), our job is to make sure that every Michigan voter who believes in democracy and the sanctity of safe and secure elections, comes out and supports our campaign.

We’re on the side of democracy, and the fundamental rights and freedoms that form the very foundation of who we are as Americans. It’s now up to us to make sure every voter knows this, and stands with us come November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=082622]

body:
Friend,
Today is Women’s Equality Day, which celebrates the adoption of the 19th Amendment, granting white women the right to vote. Since then, women have continued to work for equality in the workplace, the home, and politics – reflected in the powerful female majority in the House DFL.
This day allows us to reflect on the progress we have made, while recognizing the significant work still ahead of us. This year especially, the equality gap has been front and center with the dangerous and reckless overturning of Roe v. Wade.
There is so much on the line this election, and I am frustrated that our basic human rights are still up for debate. The House DFL will continue working to protect and expand women’s rights for as long as it takes.

subject: Barrett Calls for General Milley’s Resignation
body:
Urges Elissa Slotkin to join him | | | [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=63090f2a7ab1316c48069aa3&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62ffca639ff7426f99d11cc7%26ss_email_id%3D63090f2a7ab1316c48069aa3%26ss_campaign_name%3DBarrett%2BCalls%2Bfor%2BGeneral%2BMilley%25E2%2580%2599s%2BResignation%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-08-26T18%253A21%253A55Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=3B8vfcKAtm8fdj3o0A7ZoJosYTU%3D)
---
| **Barrett Calls for General Milley’s Resignation**(Lansing, Mich.) On the one year anniversary of the deaths of 13 Marines during the disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal, Senator Tom Barrett, who served in the U.S. Army for 22-years and is a veteran of the Iraq War, issued the following statement:**One year ago today Americans watched in horror and grief as 13 of our Marines and service members were killed and dozens more were injured in the deadliest attack on American troops in Afghanistan since President Obama’s first term.****Our Marines, who made the ultimate sacrifice in Afghanistan, represented the very best America has to offer. Sadly, the political leaders in Washington and their lapdog generals at the Pentagon do not. These “leaders,” more concerned with their political agenda than the security of our troops, failed our country and failed our Marines. Their decisions represented a true dereliction of duty.****It has been one year since this devastating and deadly attack, and there has been no accountability for any of those responsible.****Today, I am calling on Congresswoman Elissa Slotkin to join me in demanding the resignation of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs General Mark Milley.****Congresswoman, you serve the on the House Armed Services Committee, which directly oversees the Pentagon. Please do the right thing for our country and our military by joining me in this call for accountability.**
---

| Team,

Women’s Equality Day was first started to honor the passage of the 19th Amendment, which gave some women the right to vote more than 100 years ago.

And while voting rights for all women didn’t come until much later, we should still pause to celebrate not only the right for women to vote, but their participation in the political process.

Arizona has always been a leader when it comes to electing women to office. For years, Arizona led the nation in the number of women elected to our state legislature. **In fact, we’re still one of the top states for electing women, according to the National Conference of State Legislatures.**

And this year will be no different. Five of the seven statewide candidates on the ballot for our party this year are women. And even more are running for the state legislature. **_

And we intend to get every single one of them elected. _**

So while recent news makes the name of today’s holiday feel a little hollow, we remain committed to women’s equality in politics – in voting rights, in getting women elected, and in passing legislation at all levels that brings more equality to Arizona.

Thanks for your help in this work.

-AZ Dems

Kamala and I are counting on you to make your first donation to the DNC ahead of this year’s all-important midterm elections. If your budget allows for it, will you make a $7 contribution to the DNC today? I believe America is at an inflection point -- one of those moments that changes everything. America must choose, and you must choose, Derek: Are we going to be a country that moves forward -- or backwards? Are we going to build the future -- or obsess over the past? I've got 15 minutes in between meetings, friend, so I thought I'd send a quick note to you about the state of our race.
All eyes are on Georgia, and experts are saying that I'm one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection. While it's worrying, my focus has been, and always will be, getting things done for Georgians and bettering our nation.
But while I'm working in the Senate to lower costs for hardworking families, defend voting rights, and more, my opponent, Herschel Walker, is busying himself with fancy fundraisers and rallies alongside Donald Trump.
Now, everyone from _Politico_ to _FiveThirtyEight_ reports that _this_ race could decide Senate control, and the GOP is coming after me as its top target for defeat. | | | Friend: In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a 2022 Founding Donor to this history-making grassroots effort so we can keep Georgia and the Senate blue. But first, let me explain why your support today is so urgent -- and what could happen to the future of our Democratic agenda without it.

As the first-ever Black senator to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate, I don't take progress for granted. You see, I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth -- I had 11 brothers and sisters and grew up in public housing. Years later, I went on to become the senior pastor at the former church of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. -- and now, I'm fighting for working families in the Senate.

**I know what it's like to feel counted out before you even begin. That's what motivates me every day to work toward a future in which all of us have an opportunity to fulfill our God-given potential. Right now, I'm fighting hard to protect voting rights, expand affordable health care, and so much more -- but I can't win these critical fights for justice without grassroots folks like you by my side. So please, I have to ask:**

**[Will you become a Founding Donor to help my campaign and keep the Senate blue? I’m counting on your support to maintain our majority, so we can defend voting rights and protect the future of our democracy.](https://go.dscc.org/go/5319?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20220826-RaphaelWarnock-WarnockFoundingDonor-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20220826-RaphaelWarnock-WarnockFoundingDonor-Pros-sl1&akid=6213%2E9716520%2EOEETo5)**

**Plus, CNN has called me the MOST vulnerable Democratic senator in this election.** Simply put: Our Democratic agenda is hanging on by a single thread in Georgia's Senate race, and I need your grassroots help to save it.

I know what it's like to feel counted out before you even begin. That's what motivates me every day to work toward a future in which all of us have an opportunity to fulfill our God-given potential. Right now, I'm fighting hard to protect voting rights, expand affordable health care, and so much more -- but I can't win these critical fights for justice without grassroots folks like you by my side. So please, I have to ask: During the 2020 elections, we pulled out all the stops to win the battle for the Senate -- but we can't afford to sit back and relax. With the Senate split 50-50, Republicans need to flip just one seat to take back control for Mitch McConnell ‐‐ and experts confirm that the GOP have zeroed in on me as one of their top targets for defeat. Plus, CNN has called me the MOST vulnerable Democratic senator in this election. Simply put: Our Democratic agenda is hanging on by a single thread in Georgia's Senate race, and I need your grassroots help to save it. If we want to keep the Senate in Democratic hands, we have to keep Georgia blue. That's why I'm personally asking: Thanks for fighting for a better future with me. – Sen. **\- INDems Launch the “Hoosier Promise Tour” in Posey County, 8th Statewide Tour Since Last Year - ** The State Party this week launched the “Hoosier Promise Tour” to highlight the brighter future Democrats will create for the Hoosier State once elected to office on Election Day. ****
INDems launched the “Hoosier Promise Tour” in Posey County this week. The tour will comprise of its statewide ticket (Tom McDermott, Destiny Wells, ZeNai Brooks, Jessica McClellan) to Congressional and state house candidates sharing with voters about how they will solve the kitchen-table issues most important to them, including restoring a woman’s right to choose, eliminating textbook fees for students, and legalizing cannabis. The tour kicked off yesterday at the Mt. Vernon High School in Posey County and there are about 15 additional stops on the schedule. This includes Saturday’s stop in Albion. Details are below. **** The “Hoosier Promise Tour” will be the eighth statewide tour by the Indiana Democratic Party since Mike Schmuhl took over as Chairman. In that time, the state party has held more than 120 events in over 65 counties.

The Indiana Democratic Party is offering a very exciting opportunity for talented and dedicated individuals interested in gaining experience in the fast-paced world of politics. The Party is seeking to fill internship roles at its headquarters in Indianapolis. This is an outstanding opportunity to get hands-on experience working in the office of a state political party and contribute to the success of all of our Democratic candidates. _Benefits_
* Valuable skills and firsthand insight into the inner workings of the political and legislative process
* Networking with Indiana Democratic Party leaders, activists, staff, candidates, and elected officials
* Enhanced communication and organizational skills
* Work as part of a dedicated team that is interested in your personal development
* This position is a paid internship through a monthly stipend, interns will also be provided with free parking and opportunities for future training, travel, permanent positions, and career advancement in the field.
* We will work with academic institutions if interns are seeking college credit for this internship. Interns must submit the proper paperwork to the Party and their school.

_Intern Duties_
* Interns will provide administrative support to party staff. Responsibilities may include:
* Campaign research
* Voter outreach
* Data entry
* Assistance with local campaign events
* Special projects

_Qualifications_
* Applicants must be:
* Passionate about Democratic politics
* Trustworthy and responsible
* Able to communicate effectively with others
* Flexible and willing to help when needed

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220826&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220826&amount=28]
Friend,
There are a few sacred traditions in mid-Michigan, and our summer community festivals make the top of the list.
The new 7th district is home to quite a few unique summer festivals. Just in the last few weeks I’ve attended the Ox Roast in Dewitt, the Melon Festival in Howell, the Mint Festival in St. Johns, and the most unique of the bunch – Gizzard Fest in Potterville (before you ask – yes, we do have a festival dedicated to chicken gizzards).
Each event has its own unique draws – melon ice cream at Melon Fest, the Mint Princesses at Mint Festival, the Ox Roast frog jumping contest (featuring children competing to see whose frog can jump the farthest), and the giant chicken float at Gizzard Fest.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220826&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220826&amount=28]
Each of these festivals have been packed with people – we’re talking thousands – of all different backgrounds and beliefs. All of them have shown up to support their community, their small businesses, and their neighbors.
Because at the end of the day, here in mid-Michigan we may have different political views, but more importantly, we all love a good festival.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220826&amount=28]
Elissa

| | I don't think it's complicated—nobody is above the law. I don't care if you're incredibly rich or super famous or wield great power. You should have to follow the same rules as everyone else. **Unfortunately, the MAGA Republicans disagree.** A couple of weeks ago, the FBI served a warrant and seized 15 boxes of documents from former President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence. The FBI reportedly found classified materials in those boxes, including some of the most classified documents there are—things even my staff with security clearances don't get to see. What was the MAGA response? To _defund the FBI._ You can't make this stuff up. They don't have a problem with the law-breaking, they have a problem with being caught. This isn't an isolated case. The MAGA crowd is also freaking out that the Inflation Reduction Act will crack down on billionaire and corporate tax evasion. I bet you pay your taxes. You probably don't have much choice in the matter, and don't pay fancy accountants hundreds of thousands of dollars to help you cheat. But the billionaire class sure does. Their cheating costs the government an estimated $1 trillion every year! YES, $1 TRILLION. They think you should pay your taxes so they get the benefits of roads and bridges, cutting edge research, our legal and education system, and a strong national defense. And so much more while they evade paying what they owe. **Well you know what? I think that's B.S.** That's why the Inflation Reduction Act is finally cracking down on tax cheats, and just listen to the MAGA Republicans howl about it. This is what's at stake in November. The MAGA GOP thinks rules shouldn't apply to them and their billionaire, corporate donor class. Their plans to cut Social Security and Medicare, to take away rights to reproductive health care, to siphon funding from public schools—it's all about looting our shared national resources for themselves. I still live in the blue collar community I grew up in, and I know that it's community that makes us strong—each of us doing our part so all of us have a chance. There's no way I'm going to let the rich and powerful play by their own rules to take advantage of the rest of us. That's not how America is supposed to work and it's why I'm giving everything I've got to expand our Senate majority, win House seats, and hold Oregon's governorship this fall. Election season is here. We're just over two months from Election Day. It's time to bear down. All of us who believe in the rule of law and a vision of America where opportunity extends to all equally need to be in the fight. clean_body: | | | | I don't think it's complicated—nobody is above the law. I don't care if you're incredibly rich or super famous or wield great power. You should have to follow the same rules as everyone else. Unfortunately, the MAGA Republicans disagree. A couple of weeks ago, the FBI served a warrant and seized 15 boxes of documents from former President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence. The FBI reportedly found classified materials in those boxes, including some of the most classified documents there are—things even my staff with security clearances don't get to see. What was the MAGA response? To defund the FBI. You can't make this stuff up. They don't have a problem with the law-breaking, they have a problem with being caught. This isn't an isolated case. The MAGA crowd is also freaking out that the Inflation Reduction Act will crack down on billionaire and corporate tax evasion. I bet you pay your taxes. You probably don't have much choice in the matter, and don't pay fancy accountants hundreds of thousands of dollars to help you cheat. But the billionaire class sure does. Their cheating costs the government an estimated $1 trillion every year! YES, $1 TRILLION. They think you should pay your taxes so they get the benefits of roads and bridges, cutting edge research, our legal and education system, and a strong national defense. And so much more while they evade paying what they owe. Well you know what? I think that's B.S. That's why the Inflation Reduction Act is finally cracking down on tax cheats, and just listen to the MAGA Republicans howl about it. This is what's at stake in November. The MAGA GOP thinks rules shouldn't apply to them and their billionaire, corporate donor class. Their plans to cut Social Security and Medicare, to take away rights to reproductive health care, to siphon funding from public schools—it's all about looting our shared national resources for themselves. I still live in the blue collar community I grew up in, and I know that it's community that makes us strong—each of us doing our part so all of us have a chance. There's no way I'm going to let the rich and powerful play by their own rules to take advantage of the rest of us. That's not how America is supposed to work and it's why I'm giving everything I've got to expand our Senate majority, win House seats, and hold Oregon's governorship this fall. Election season is here. We're just over two months from Election Day. It's time to bear down. All of us who believe in the rule of law and a vision of America where opportunity extends to all equally need to be in the fight. subject: Student Loan Cancellation: An Explainer

body:
This is a long email, but we hope it helps explain the student loan plan. | | | Peter, On Wednesday, President Biden announced his plan to tackle the student debt crisis. The plan includes federal student loan cancellation of up to $20,000 and adjustments to the income requirements for paying back federal loans. The plan is welcome news for millions burdened with student debt. It's also a credit to years of organizing. Many activists and organizations — including WFP members across the country — have been fighting for relief for the student debt crisis. And while this plan doesn’t go far enough in relieving those who have been exploited by a broken higher education system, it’s a big step forward for this movement. It also sets a precedent for future executive actions — including further debt relief. We know that trying to understand wonky plans and laws, especially around our already-confusing student loan system, can be difficult, so we want to answer some of the main questions around this new plan.
* * *
**I have student loan debt — what do I have to do?** You must have a direct loan through the federal government that you received before June 30, 2022 in order to be eligible for the loan cancellation program. A federal direct loan is the most common form of student loan and is the only type of loan that can be cancelled by the federal government — not private loans. Note that the application is not yet available, but the Department of Education said it will be made available by the end of 2022. All direct loans are eligible, including loans to parents and graduate students, as long as they were received before June 30 of this year. **What happens after I apply?** After a currently unknown period of time, the government will determine if you are eligible for loan cancellation. As far as we know right now, the only qualifications are:
* Having federal direct loan debt
* Having earned less than $125,000 as an individual or $250,000 as part of a married couple in 2020 or 2021

**I qualify for debt cancellation — how much can I get cancelled?** If your balance is less than $10,000, your entire loan will be cancelled. You will not owe the federal loan service any more money. Congratulations! If your balance is over $10,000, you will only have a maximum of $10,000 cancelled, unless you received a Pell Grant. If you received a Pell Grant while enrolled in college, the amount that can be cancelled goes up to $20,000. If you’re not sure if you received a Pell Grant or not, [click here to learn how to check.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhpwmY_DHMAZqFSLUrpAn-ppoZc6PonYZGmyPdl2_vPHwhm_wk8jmqhmRzt09fDI1Zsiq3iGdoKPIR6UqOBL2CxTCUd2lN6NEVAoyBzxQGscUghvfJTX-__eNID-QluY2m-BCJpF_O0K0ASqtuwJaLpxIXiLGsvk3RFcd-WVRMOgvf7_Gf_H3sFh17AKY_PjgR7AbwKShjjefJcQRAFVMXdhM3ky4hGbXAq7PK1S_f0BZf3PKoSjkWLesA4_30yKAotnhK4_d2cittMNfyHASDTIzrtPvTcE5uurC1Ub8mgSMkIkgFXhLX1MQlCUeDMGTEgRqsR-xDEkaIzK1IqHKYxI/3ox/Ul6iZDpHT-O3XSJiLEa17g/h0/4n6IKr_a2CotDFijqe6EB1bCoXcP3feWUXx0gfpee-U) **I had some of my debt cancelled, but not all of it. Now what?** You are not required to continue making payments on your federal student loans until January 2023. **I might have to take out more student loans in the future. Is anything changing for current or future students?** Yes! There are quite a few changes in the plan around the requirements for paying off current or future student loan debt. First, they want to raise the minimum income requirement required for loan repayment to 225% of the federal poverty level — aka no one making $15 an hour or less will be required to make monthly payments on student loan debt. They are also reducing the minimum required payment for monthly payments to 5% of the discretionary income — cutting that minimum monthly payment in half. Speaking of cutting things in half, they’re also going to cancel loan balances after 10 years of regular payments, instead of 20 years, for borrowers with loan balances of $12,000 or less. So, if you’ve been paying your monthly payments for 10 years and you still owe $12,000 or less, they will cancel your entire balance. And here’s another really big change: As long as you are making your minimum monthly payments — even if you aren’t paying due to a low income — your debt will not grow. Basically, the federal loan will not gain interest if you are consistent and pay every month.
* * *
Now that we answered a few questions around the Biden Administration's Student Loan Debt Relief Plan, we have a question for you. **[What does student loan cancellation mean for you? How will this plan affect your life? clean_body: This is a long email, but we hope it helps explain the student loan plan. | | | Peter, On Wednesday, President Biden announced his plan to tackle the student debt crisis. The plan includes federal student loan cancellation of up to $20,000 and adjustments to the income requirements for paying back federal loans. The plan is welcome news for millions burdened with student debt. It's also a credit to years of organizing. Many activists and organizations — including WFP members across the country — have been fighting for relief for the student debt crisis. And while this plan doesn’t go far enough in relieving those who have been exploited by a broken higher education system, it’s a big step forward for this movement. It also sets a precedent for future executive actions — including further debt relief. We know that trying to understand wonky plans and laws, especially around our already-confusing student loan system, can be difficult, so we want to answer some of the main questions around this new plan. I have student loan debt — what do I have to do? You must have a direct loan through the federal government that you received before June 30, 2022 in order to be eligible for the loan cancellation program. A federal direct loan is the most common form of student loan and is the only type of loan that can be cancelled by the federal government — not private loans. Note that the application is not yet available, but the Department of Education said it will be made available by the end of 2022. All direct loans are eligible, including loans to parents and graduate students, as long as they were received before June 30 of this year. What happens after I apply? After a currently unknown period of time, the government will determine if you are eligible for loan cancellation. As far as we know right now, the only qualifications are: Having federal direct loan debt Having earned less than $125,000 as an individual or $250,000 as part of a married couple in 2020 or 2021 I qualify for debt cancellation — how much can I get cancelled? If your balance is less than $10,000, your entire loan will be cancelled. You will not owe the federal loan service any more money. Congratulations! If your balance is over $10,000, you will only have a maximum of $10,000 cancelled, unless you received a Pell Grant. If you received a Pell Grant while enrolled in college, the amount that can be cancelled goes up to $20,000. If you’re not sure if you received a Pell Grant or not, I had some of my debt cancelled, but not all of it. Now what? You are not required to continue making payments on your federal student loans until January 2023. I might have to take out more student loans in the future. Is anything changing for current or future students? Yes! There are quite a few changes in the plan around the requirements for paying off current or future student loan debt. First, they want to raise the minimum income requirement required for loan repayment to 225% of the federal poverty level — aka no one making $15 an hour or less will be required to make monthly payments on student loan debt. They are also reducing the minimum required payment for monthly payments to 5% of the discretionary income — cutting that minimum monthly payment in half. Speaking of cutting things in half, they’re also going to cancel loan balances after 10 years of regular payments, instead of 20 years, for borrowers with loan balances of $12,000 or less. So, if you’ve been paying your monthly payments for 10 years and you still owe $12,000 or less, they will cancel your entire balance. And here’s another really big change: As long as you are making your minimum monthly payments — even if you aren’t paying due to a low income — your debt will not grow. Basically, the federal loan will not gain interest if you are consistent and pay every month. Now that we answered a few questions around the Biden Administration's Student Loan Debt Relief Plan, we have a question for you. Or share your story on social media and tag us @WorkingFamilies on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram. Cancelling student loan debt is a profoundly personal policy issue at the nexus of racial justice, economic security, and educational equity. When you share your story with us and others, you help amplify the many reasons why we’re going to continue to push the President to cancel student loan debt once and for all. In solidarity, The Working Families Party team Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. | | | | | Peter, **Ron DeSantis has turned Florida and America into a danger zone.** **A clownish, crude and colic disgrace to Florida. The examples are endless.** His firing Rebekah Jones from the Health Dept--as we've written you about--for keeping accurate COVID numbers, ones that would show how many Floridians he actually allowed to get sick and die by ignoring the crisis (Florida ended up suffering more than any other state). He sent state officers into her home, to point guns at her children and threaten her, when he found out she was continuing to keep track of COVID numbers on her own. DeSantis punished Disney for being inclusive to the gay & lesbian community, he punished the Tampa Bay Rays for sharing accurate information on gun violence via their Twitter feed and, most recently, he suspended a Tampa prosecutor, Adam Warren, who said he wouldn't prosecute abortion cases because the state's previous laws on privacy and abortion are still unclear. **[So can you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Charlie Crist, so we can stop the totalitarian DeSantis from further destroying Florida, and ever getting his grubby little hands on the United States?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T29afb0a4-91e4-40d2-901f-8bda6a7a6197/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **DeSantis is dictatorial, degrading and an enemy of American democracy. **_But even all of that couldn't prepare us for the video he just released "Top Gov," a takeoff on Top Gun so cringe-inducing that it's impossible to watch and not keel over from second-hand embarrassment. _ _DeSantis puts on a flight suit to--which is stolen valor, he was a military lawyer, but he never served in combat--and a helmet on his oversized nugget that is so tight it makes it look like he's squeezing a melon through hoop earring. _ **_Desantis is as unserious as he is evil, and if we don't stop him now, he will have a good shot at being President in 2024, as lunatics like Alex Jones--who, sadly, have a ton of influence in today's GOP--line up behind him._** _**The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. **_

The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. | | | | | | Crist wil fight for abortion rights, gun safety, policies to battle climate change, universal voting rights and he believes in democracy, not the dictatorship DeSanis has foisted upon Florida--and would do to the United States, if given the chance. As a former Governor, Attorney General & current Congressman, Crist has great name recognition, and as a former Republican, a ton of appeal to former moderate Republicans horrified at what their party's become because of men like DeSantis. Recent polls show him within a few points of DeSantis, and focus groups show undecided voters mostly repelled by DeSantis. When Crist ran against incumbent Governor Rick Scott in 2014, he lost by less than one point, even though Scott spent tens of millions of his own money- -or perhaps we should accurately call it his ill-gotten gains from overseeing the largest Medicare fraud case in U.S. history. Crist can win. He can even be outspent and win. But, after a tough primary, Ron DeSantis has an ENORMOUS FINANCIAL ADVANTAGE. We MUST change this. There honestly is no time to waste, we must stop DeSantis NOW. Think back to some of history's worst tyrants, and imagine what it would've been like if we'd stopped them along the way. I'm not being hyperbolic, DeSantis is just-as-evil as Trump, yet, luckily for us, possesses the charisma of drying paint. We. Can. Beat. Him. Thank you so much for helping us fight the dictator-in-waiting Desantis.
