It's a slap in the face to the American taxpayer. What Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. Exclusive invitation enclosed to join my club of top supporters from throughout the country. One big caveat - you have to join Friday before midnight.

| [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=63e09d0bc8c04e19baedc0c43acce42f&_e=GDhDM3jWfVOCGLXGr4lXd6fUwBSJPpsFdkdc13Hw_ALP2nbU9i6E8L6DQtNsMCYQ-QgEoSr1vfanL4AsmGWUV2LrmzNt0k2Hhd4RUQmgM3cY0lS-z-32PzEQPMMmIVaQ-HaOJCBM3p1R29LqIv4c8RwgT_m5Va9z8CRz70DCCBtUYyTonnJScl0PH6yqT_T9lyA4YUVebVFPDhZKwDNrdm4e3K1VsjSv8Sqq5ID-En-Z87WXeW6tOFY873ofSsPBtJQCoghw9W629GOf2ikiFuxXY-tmJ71YSXboWXyhfgkDOS1P8A0WEb13Wnlh5HWL)
---

Peter,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

And frankly, we can't get much of anything done if people don't trust our leaders to act with integrity and accountability. There's a real choice to be made in this election. | | Not sure if you heard...

Governor Brad Little called a "special session" of the legislature to dole out money before his election.

It happens on Thursday, Sept. 1st, and includes:
1. A barely noticeable tax cut...
2. Giving Idahoans a few hundred dollars via direct payment (BEFORE the election)...
3. Giving "education" over $400 MILLION in a one-time lump sum payment...
4. Massively increasing spending for "education" year after year...

This is essentially a bill to give the education lobby money while adding in some measly tax cuts in to mask it. Plus, due to how it's written, it's possibly illegal and unconstitutional because the bill tackles 3 things in ONE bill (the ID state constitution says one bill, one subject).

Instead of Idahoans getting real and SIGNIFICANT relief... Governor Little wants to give it to the education lobby.

This reminds me of California.

The education lobby here is a **Leviathan.**

So... what to do?
1. Read a bit more about it [HERE](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=d56b31d71b&e=dea908e0fe "Read more here").
2. See if YOUR Senator and /or Representatives signed on to co-sponsor the bill [HERE](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=fdf6e4e8f9&e=dea908e0fe "Is your Senator/Rep on the list?").
3. Email all of your representatives either way and let them know you're NOT okay with Brad Little dumping money into education while regular Idahoans suffer... [email them HERE](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=8da5cbccc6&e=dea908e0fe "Email them here, easy to use tool").
4. Show up at the Boise capitol on September 1st and _fill the committee rooms and gallery_.
5. Share this info with everyone.

Cheers,

Brian

Fellow Conservative,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=46f51b025ba04cf6a2b58264647f3b5c&_e=3B7oXmbLmV0Q9UFjik3E9HgHGFELV2DTfamBo5b3XNYfAXfiODQSFp3hdjrTMT_vwHj7N1tRq7LbYiGSdGY2xrh9gYhjuTdM7iizsyrZyHztU-0P5jY2zDef14ViSe_M2OJYYISaabs1ZXvf8VoT7bTL_RSm9tvFRlxfoajqfxENdLrBhTX8kPJHmf6fJH8_4p8iuWdvEA_xpqRFhwL2-NQ4WeK_c59Y9grMmz3BCvFH0z-yBgTKZ8l0rd_oHwpPKMYSAePIH56Egw9S-cw9XKLRhfpFdCGuRCVHilEoAXac0mAEMEUcSzhG1QmVj69E)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=46f51b025ba04cf6a2b58264647f3b5c&_e=3B7oXmbLmV0Q9UFjik3E9HgHGFELV2DTfamBo5b3XNYfAXfiODQSFp3hdjrTMT_vwHj7N1tRq7LbYiGSdGY2xrh9gYhjuTdM7iizsyrZyHztU-0P5jY2zDef14ViSe_M2OJYYISaabs1ZXvf8VoT7bTL_RSm9tvFRlxfoajqfxHsUL7-HLRDRJbHsB-kdtszPYjYCAlLhkYhiwyRXqJ0iVvYpEizqd0q70VMdohmFMtofIhUEwK5R00bq8o_cFzSWaw3qc5eR3oljJZmpkZrUxV6k5nU1rraRySkWeaAQXmlYC63xdVJPCkVJUCRvLzu)

Every dollar that’s borrowed must be paid back. But what Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. **Rather, they’ll be paid back by taxpayers like us!**

**Just to appease his most socialist supporters on the left, and in an attempt to energize younger voters before what is shaping up to be a difficult election for Democrats, Biden just launched a quarter-trillion-dollar tax and spend program that promotes fiscal irresponsibility and unfair treatment of those who took out students loans and paid them back.**

name: Max Steiner
subject: David Zink sign vandalized at Butte County Fair
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
Someone took a sharpie to his sign, writing "FJB" and drawing devil horns on his face. | |
---
Friend,
By this point, you probably know that I like going to fairs. They're a great place to meet people and make a political pitch - and more politicians need to meet people and make a pitch, rather than relying on advertising or Big Media-driven fear mongering. That fear, and the anger it generates, is unfortunately alive and well. My counterpart running for State Assembly District 3 (roughly Tehama, Butte, Glenn, Sutter, and Yuba) had his sign vandalized the night before the fair opened. Someone took a sharpie to his sign, writing "FJB" and drawing devil horns on his face. Is it juvenile, yes. However, it speaks to a subset of right-wing voters who hypocritically preach the values of "freedom of speech" and "property rights" even as they vandalize the property of someone they disagree with. To steal a phrase from Hilary Clinton, these vandals truly are "deplorable." **Make no mistake, most GOP objections to "cancel culture" are just projection. The people on the right complaining the loudest about "snowflakes" on the left are the first to go yell at a school board when their kid brings home a book that challenges their conservative point of view.

clean_body: Make no mistake: No matter what state you live in, reproductive health care is on the ballot this November. | | | [BREAKING] Three anti-abortion trigger laws just went into effect this week in Texas, Tennessee, and Idaho. We are counting on this team to urgently invest in the organizing and GOTV efforts it will take to hold the GOP accountable for their anti-choice agenda at the ballot box in just 74 days. In Texas -- which does not allow abortions for survivors of rape and incest -- physicians who perform abortions will now risk facing large fines and up to life in prison. In Tennessee, an already strict abortion law has become even more draconian with a near-total ban -- with no exceptions for survivors of rape or incest. In Idaho, extreme MAGA Republicans’ trigger law bans nearly all abortions. Make no mistake: No matter what state you live in, reproductive health care is on the ballot this November. And it is up to this team to hold the GOP accountable for their extreme anti-choice agenda in just 74 days. We’re counting on you to step up for the first time in this critical moment. Rush $7 to the Democratic National Committee to support the on-the-ground organizing, voter protection work, and more it will take to elect Democrats ready to fight for reproductive rights and more. Every day is a reminder of how extreme Republicans are -- they’re even willing to go as far as banning abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest and threatening doctors with prison. In many states, electing Democratic governors, attorneys general, state legislatures, and federal representatives is the last line of defense for Americans’ reproductive rights. name: Cheri Beasley
subject: You deserve a personal explanation
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in myself and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us.

Team - I’m reaching out myself to ask you to consider making a $3 donation to our campaign ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline. But before I ask, you deserve an explanation of why your support is so important.
Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us. Winning a race as tough as this has to be a team effort. It requires all of us to do the hard work together.
Right now is a moment when we need folks like you to come through for our campaign. We noticed a bit of a fundraising slow down this past week during our budget meeting, and honestly, it was a bit concerning.
My opponent has at least five different outside groups spending on his behalf. Some of the biggest special interests in politics are aggressively trying to buy this seat — including a Koch-backed super PAC, a major corporate special interest group and two of McConnell’s super PACs.
I don’t believe this seat or our next senator’s vote should be for sale. We need a leader who will always put people first. That’s why our campaign is rejecting corporate PAC money.
So that’s why your support is so important. Whether you can pitch in $3 or any amount you can afford, no donation is too small.
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat? We still have a lot of ground to cover to help us close our fundraising gap before our 8/31 deadline.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220826-3-MA&t=1&akid=1555%2E357359%2EKas5LN)

Fellow American,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=807a171d5b0e4052b27cc49b5baecbdc&_e=MUOZmmdHgCBg0R_6R8gYMdxyUoyOjAGaLIf9Cj4OFZGedpEpepWfWKdcV13c62GrbjMXVl5CUSuxIQCZ3M5pDHGL1LDMfKsrvcqNWoAr3aXlfsYSP2UTlqM-x7ffos3dCqRHXh8UlNIMk9lU6A3TyAnQNTbE_uoRQ-TixjzZKIL8gk0w6IIcMwWzG6ZJ_xx-lTeLRimelKF0Tw9K5P7jf8DZTplfs1_RWRzP4h6WY1ecALKwGojDA3i0Xuc0w5GairEftaFmTb5GJIHSrD87hgGLj-yvBvQLv8z965hpn8fHps3moRCqihPPpMbrSqTTqGu4ze06kO4N7LgL6dx3bu8EJyq3mzeBahbg-UVtH3gPYpEadefuOD7hcvzFBkoIGvd2hSfTE7VWYpnHRGlH4a8DLCwLrwiBZd7G9nHv8Fq4NtjihJCyJKOfbZ1rsADs)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

It's a slap in the face to the American taxpayer. What Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. Exclusive invitation enclosed to join my club of top supporters from throughout the country. One big caveat - you have to join Friday before midnight.

| [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b0f13876ed9046d1ac588acead2cb726&_e=hclo0d3hzZoq67_0315gglfQsQ87vL7LHs9VbYYoAojVUEvFvGZDpKxJG6iInduldSaIxLS9e2IuZ8loc6VS3OS5Hw2mNCJft5_ex5iBFEIysreLewAoyHcfG19NSgq5ZeWfOWT71FPKV9Edtc948igMXT-wUVATpEJJSEdBr76AopFu0cD-BIxiHd0R6gJhBRCyQ5EJ5PYfAKwokYNe_QmQzn6Nbsw_b202LpKxqU-A11O0jEgPbfWK5ZeaXm86iqmD_9xL1HnmwzUdLAvj00-5lLA3K8CqwbrI_049__IYFycDxHvhoQNpe2w0qsAY)

Fellow Conservative,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b0f13876ed9046d1ac588acead2cb726&_e=hclo0d3hzZoq67_0315gglfQsQ87vL7LHs9VbYYoAojVUEvFvGZDpKxJG6iInduldSaIxLS9e2IuZ8loc6VS3OS5Hw2mNCJft5_ex5iBFEIysreLewAoyHcfG19NSgq5ZeWfOWT71FPKV9Edtc948igMXT-wUVATpEJJSEdBr742t43m2gdSy-2Njuyj-Cey1-4NiKXXwpAE9W5TxuPDvW4NnjE-qVeI3xRq5TwuqcFcPQ8Y9XTYbO67HcyDAOMOGvXm4Fb4AW0FMBUlWPYvejYEFWNpV8g4JwcVxhClbhpP9FXBLb-mY-hd63G8uz9-)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b0f13876ed9046d1ac588acead2cb726&_e=hclo0d3hzZoq67_0315gglfQsQ87vL7LHs9VbYYoAojVUEvFvGZDpKxJG6iInduldSaIxLS9e2IuZ8loc6VS3OS5Hw2mNCJft5_ex5iBFEIysreLewAoyHcfG19NSgq5ZeWfOWT71FPKV9Edtc948igMXT-wUVATpEJJSEdBr75QcWSNlicm2wh2cWW9czF1nvtOkC5fMEJkqVL68IYJbfIAhPubhmSu2gqkuldo6hLGWzQ2ZztPzmOL1tuN46vrftFRaVeFXg4IMRQ6dVZSTxbGSBo9PTjA2AJJspjuDwTacp5DK1EeFyDEHxWBsyJ8)

Every dollar that’s borrowed must be paid back. But what Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. **Rather, they’ll be paid back by taxpayers like us!**

**Just to appease his most socialist supporters on the left, and in an attempt to energize younger voters before what is shaping up to be a difficult election for Democrats, Biden just launched a quarter-trillion-dollar tax and spend program that promotes fiscal irresponsibility and unfair treatment of those who took out students loans and paid them back.**

**[I really want to know where you stand on this issue – so please do me a favor and take my quick 3 question survey today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b0f13876ed9046d1ac588acead2cb726&_e=hclo0d3hzZoq67_0315gglfQsQ87vL7LHs9VbYYoAojVUEvFvGZDpKxJG6iInduldSaIxLS9e2IuZ8loc6VS3OS5Hw2mNCJft5_ex5iBFEIysreLewAoyHcfG19NSgq5ZeWfOWT71FPKV9Edtc948igMXT-wUVATpEJJSEdBr77MUHvtg4PnxVnGwmcmdYJsCACUASdHtqRWovZqV-UPf35COgZ1nXm-j9hCgCGoWanxKOoe1aDE1StI3SNfSAyG1w7n1duzJVLCrJef0FsK6dP7vOngrrRCJw-A1_VD9cuKlJOWoATL0vcznZMP5KVd)**

For Liberty,
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b0f13876ed9046d1ac588acead2cb726&_e=hclo0d3hzZoq67_0315gglfQsQ87vL7LHs9VbYYoAojVUEvFvGZDpKxJG6iInduldSaIxLS9e2IuZ8loc6VS3OS5Hw2mNCJft5_ex5iBFEIysreLewAoyHcfG19NSgq5ZeWfOWT71FPKV9Edtc948igMXT-wUVATpEJJSEdBr76_w7Q55GdfrMygkAmXyAkyP9inyzZ3OLD_pcNsS-W4DQxcaedmWCYxpkTSLE7KO-aq-kFExIAx1uF7nqsar7uLwch8v8s7WGwczx_uPqdDEFDGhxzWggmRAzLPzIj0_D50wbaDxc-v-PQVOhJyvu2W)

body:
Charlie Crist for Florida!
| | | | |

---

---
| | | | | Peter, can you help us save Florida from Ron DeSantis? **Ron DeSantis has turned Florida and America into a danger zone.** **A clownish, crude and colic disgrace to Florida. The examples are endless.** His firing Rebekah Jones from the Health Dept--as we've written you about--for keeping accurate COVID numbers, ones that would show how many Floridians he actually allowed to get sick and die by ignoring the crisis (Florida ended up suffering more than any other state). He sent state officers into her home, to point guns at her children and threaten her, when he found out she was continuing to keep track of COVID numbers on her own. DeSantis punished Disney for being inclusive to the gay & lesbian community, he punished the Tampa Bay Rays for sharing accurate information on gun violence via their Twitter feed and, most recently, he suspended a Tampa prosecutor, Adam Warren, who said he wouldn't prosecute abortion cases because the state's previous laws on privacy and abortion are still unclear. **[So can you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Charlie Crist, so we can stop the totalitarian DeSantis from further destroying Florida, and ever getting his grubby little hands on the United States?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce01a598-8414-456b-b732-7d40ed180d04/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **DeSantis is dictatorial, degrading and an enemy of American democracy. **_But even all of that couldn't prepare us for the video he just released "Top Gov," a takeoff on Top Gun so cringe-inducing that it's impossible to watch and not keel over from second-hand embarrassment. _ _DeSantis puts on a flight suit to--which is stolen valor, he was a military lawyer, but he never served in combat--and a helmet on his oversized nugget that is so tight it makes it look like he's squeezing a melon through hoop earring. _ **_DeSantis is as unserious as he is evil, and if we don't stop him now, he will have a good shot at being President in 2024, as lunatics like Alex Jones--who, sadly, have a ton of influence in today's GOP--line up behind him._** _**The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. **_

Recent polls show him within a few points of DeSantis, and focus groups show undecided voters mostly repelled by DeSantis. _** _When Crist ran against incumbent Governor Rick Scott in 2014, he lost by less than one point, even though Scott spent tens of millions of his own money-_ -or perhaps we should accurately call it his ill-gotten gains from overseeing the largest Medicare fraud case in U.S. history. **Crist can win. DeSantis punished Disney for being inclusive to the gay & lesbian community, he punished the Tampa Bay Rays for sharing accurate information on gun violence via their Twitter feed and, most recently, he suspended a Tampa prosecutor, Adam Warren, who said he wouldn't prosecute abortion cases because the state's previous laws on privacy and abortion are still unclear. DeSantis is dictatorial, degrading and an enemy of American democracy. But even all of that couldn't prepare us for the video he just released "Top Gov," a takeoff on Top Gun so cringe-inducing that it's impossible to watch and not keel over from second-hand embarrassment. DeSantis puts on a flight suit to--which is stolen valor, he was a military lawyer, but he never served in combat--and a helmet on his oversized nugget that is so tight it makes it look like he's squeezing a melon through hoop earring. DeSantis is as unserious as he is evil, and if we don't stop him now, he will have a good shot at being President in 2024, as lunatics like Alex Jones--who, sadly, have a ton of influence in today's GOP--line up behind him. The winner of the Democratic primary in Florida, Charlie Crist is a well-known entity in Florida. A never Trumper before it was cool, he left the GOP when the Tea Party wave of 2010 produced such right wing reactionaries--like Marco Rubio--it was clear to him the GOP was no longer his party. | | | | | | Crist wil fight for abortion rights, gun safety, policies to battle climate change, universal voting rights and he believes in democracy, not the dictatorship DeSanis has foisted upon Florida--and would do to the United States, if given the chance. As a former Governor, Attorney General & current Congressman, Crist has great name recognition, and as a former Republican, a ton of appeal to former moderate Republicans horrified at what their party's become because of men like DeSantis. Recent polls show him within a few points of DeSantis, and focus groups show undecided voters mostly repelled by DeSantis. When Crist ran against incumbent Governor Rick Scott in 2014, he lost by less than one point, even though Scott spent tens of millions of his own money- -or perhaps we should accurately call it his ill-gotten gains from overseeing the largest Medicare fraud case in U.S. history. Crist can win. He can even be outspent and win. But, after a tough primary, Ron DeSantis has an ENORMOUS FINANCIAL ADVANTAGE. We MUST change this. There honestly is no time to waste, we must stop DeSantis NOW. Think back to some of history's worst tyrants, and imagine what it would've been like if we'd stopped them along the way. I'm not being hyperbolic, DeSantis is just-as-evil as Trump, yet, luckily for us, possesses the charisma of drying paint. We. Can. Beat. Him. Thank you so much for helping us fight the dictator-in-waiting Desantis. I wanted to take a moment to tell you about my roots
| | |
---
As your _official_ Democratic nominee for Florida's U.S. Senate seat, I wanted to take a moment to tell you about my roots.
I was born in Jacksonville, Florida in 1957, the youngest of seven children. My mother was a maid and my father was a janitor, and I'll be honest, money was tight at times. But still, that didn't stop my parents from working hard to give me the world.
This photo is from my first trip to Washington, D.C., so many years ago, when I visited the city on a class trip. The trip was expensive – more than I thought we could afford – but my dad took out an advance on his next paycheck so he could send me to the nation's capital.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49810842/363540980/1672908452?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4150-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWJjOTFkMC05MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dQK8gmQ4yQKKXSg4jjPxWQPaLpfdhiR4wHLmMKsdHKA=)
After this trip, _everything_ was different. I began to consider a career in service and, after graduating college (the first in my family to do so!), I made the decision to enter the police academy at a time when so few police officers were Black and female.
After a few years on the force in Orlando, I was elected as chief of police – the first woman _ever _to fill that rank on the Orlando Police Department! I served as a law enforcement officer for nearly 30 years, and my work even allowed me to meet President Obama!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49810843/363540981/1672908452?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4150-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWJjOTFkMC05MjI1LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dQK8gmQ4yQKKXSg4jjPxWQPaLpfdhiR4wHLmMKsdHKA=)
But after so many decades spent protecting and serving the people of Orlando, I knew that my career in service was nowhere near finished. It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father.
[](http://links.doctoroz.com/u/click?_t=2b05aaee21f04e6792020c0ad1924b95&_m=dbfd850c09f545ffb100e41b86a4c817&_e=Np3rkQOjSobSxUGvuf8qY_lmYTfoeqOI4LW3MQNuoydhRSZSmTCkrOnJAlsT3wlRO5JgQWOizuqV71y-5Y9xzE-gXXTudjEpiIJ-LgtS_kMB6ZqHbOqtmbdiUyW9T1GX2hYdJdtCy6J4H16BbtZ5clh7g4gKkBsdh9q2bqDRbJsZSE22N-dfsekw1VplrOoAgj5AY2fTPdP1SRfBHuwiP-wO9IJWQ9QAr7B3qGlOBCrX_fMVWxMsGlhJ5LiTIEG4Lg7stp-H-FaMMT42S_fR83RgIElpOQJu9rcSXSHU9wxF3jrC9sfk5zfj281TG35nMPWDIwDvOL7oy73ByCRQlZIb20AMr5p9QGYUH4w_t660XzZgTxUs7tWz4nk2IaWz3AFnAkbAJW4PohSvgS7wy-dzKLAkdxCLrKbcxi91LNlpZHXlHoyQ8bZ-B-oVEOfEeUVlBAcbE4OkmNi_VH_EY9iX1Ls9coGaAzKZI2jU-Hw%3D)
This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream.
[](http://links.doctoroz.com/u/click?_t=2b05aaee21f04e6792020c0ad1924b95&_m=dbfd850c09f545ffb100e41b86a4c817&_e=Np3rkQOjSobSxUGvuf8qY_lmYTfoeqOI4LW3MQNuoydhRSZSmTCkrOnJAlsT3wlRO5JgQWOizuqV71y-5Y9xzE-gXXTudjEpiIJ-LgtS_kMB6ZqHbOqtmbdiUyW9T1GX2hYdJdtCy6J4H16BbtZ5clh7g4gKkBsdh9q2bqDRbJsZSE22N-dfsekw1VplrOoAgj5AY2fTPdP1SRfBHuwiP-wO9IJWQ9QAr7B3qGlOBCrX_fMVWxMsGlhJ5LiTIEG4Lg7stp-H-FaMMT42S_fR83RgIElpOQJu9rcSXSHU9wxF3jrC9sfk5zfj281TG35nMPWDIwDvOL7oy73ByCRQlaqKkRc24ClPyGKwjOp-I0KBjB3jLAIYDjFSxCKbVj4nK8AjcRwjBgmXzW-qjc2OH_Kj5hifP1VqbteV4mqfcEOoaojJSHJvvGpJfs546ClpahDqjoRVPx8seoKkek5RsBhmJXuKjDg_ufPaQXNipEs%3D)
**The middle:** I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her.
[](http://links.doctoroz.com/u/click?_t=2b05aaee21f04e6792020c0ad1924b95&_m=dbfd850c09f545ffb100e41b86a4c817&_e=Np3rkQOjSobSxUGvuf8qY_lmYTfoeqOI4LW3MQNuoydhRSZSmTCkrOnJAlsT3wlRO5JgQWOizuqV71y-5Y9xzE-gXXTudjEpiIJ-LgtS_kMB6ZqHbOqtmbdiUyW9T1GX2hYdJdtCy6J4H16BbtZ5clh7g4gKkBsdh9q2bqDRbJsZSE22N-dfsekw1VplrOoAgj5AY2fTPdP1SRfBHuwiP-wO9IJWQ9QAr7B3qGlOBCrX_fMVWxMsGlhJ5LiTIEG4Lg7stp-H-FaMMT42S_fR83RgIElpOQJu9rcSXSHU9wxF3jrC9sfk5zfj281TG35nMPWDIwDvOL7oy73ByCRQldlhqVemyMsbpcQa972da73R2_H4I-LIIPiM5kBpKZ69n-N-C_vjXlUEUn1MDagsTdZ4MCKjxxlKtRnoUiGrEhDmjOU9Yig_h8Q33Wxd1gmWvQEgeUL4N63I6Y7t6CLpULPZOupU3iF3-W3ZPrGEyyE%3D)
Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate:
**You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree.** [](http://links.doctoroz.com/u/click?_t=2b05aaee21f04e6792020c0ad1924b95&_m=dbfd850c09f545ffb100e41b86a4c817&_e=Np3rkQOjSobSxUGvuf8qY_lmYTfoeqOI4LW3MQNuoydhRSZSmTCkrOnJAlsT3wlRO5JgQWOizuqV71y-5Y9xzE-gXXTudjEpiIJ-LgtS_kMB6ZqHbOqtmbdiUyW9T1GX2hYdJdtCy6J4H16BbtZ5clh7g4gKkBsdh9q2bqDRbJsZSE22N-dfsekw1VplrOoAgj5AY2fTPdP1SRfBHuwiP-wO9IJWQ9QAr7B3qGlOBCrX_fMVWxMsGlhJ5LiTIEG4Lg7stp-H-FaMMT42S_fR83RgIElpOQJu9rcSXSHU9wxF3jrC9sfk5zfj281TG35nMPWDIwDvOL7oy73ByCRQlXyQH9wacyZ4ZCLSbMSXsXM_JFid9yq383mz11igwFyP69DwSxt3WjJDAhqdNpqjKUJ95_h-uIXZPeiTuygKn9Uy1Q99rPpRtJRReISZ_FxOuSNtpb6PvLdWrHWEB5FiMZwdHnr5Qvt9yRQeH6s4Ubk%3D)
**The now:** After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations.

**This brings me to my main point:** I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – _except for YOU._
[](http://links.doctoroz.com/u/click?_t=2b05aaee21f04e6792020c0ad1924b95&_m=dbfd850c09f545ffb100e41b86a4c817&_e=Np3rkQOjSobSxUGvuf8qY_lmYTfoeqOI4LW3MQNuoydhRSZSmTCkrOnJAlsT3wlRO5JgQWOizuqV71y-5Y9xzE-gXXTudjEpiIJ-LgtS_kMB6ZqHbOqtmbdiUyW9T1GX2hYdJdtCy6J4H16BbtZ5clh7g4gKkBsdh9q2bqDRbJsZSE22N-dfsekw1VplrOoAgj5AY2fTPdP1SRfBHuwiP-wO9IJWQ9QAr7B3qGlOBCrX_fMVWxMsGlhJ5LiTIEG4Lg7stp-H-FaMMT42S_fR83RgIElpOQJu9rcSXSHU9wxF3jrC9sfk5zfj281TG35nMPWDIwDvOL7oy73ByCRQlTKxTHN57b5N8AoMi0NWHOmdhR1LZgwROY9LL2Dgo02s9g8mh-KCKwJdacJYcOE0duPwuUiByhwEMavnvKsFfGsT0XSMCEAWwX0T9nTaaM8ZnU3NMjMb3bQNQ4m82-pPYFNnXMjOTNj37x8UML5Myms%3D)

clean_body: the Five Ws | It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important... The beginning: My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father. This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream. The middle: I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her. Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate: You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree. The now: After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations. This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – except for YOU. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Dr. Mehmet Oz Dr. Mehmet Oz is a Trump-endorsed, America First Conservative running for U.S. Senate to reignite our divine spark, fight for freedom and return the power to you. to ensure that he has the support he needs to become Pennsylvania’s next Senator. subject: Matt has FAILED Montana's Women and Children
body:
One of my proudest accomplishments is co-founding the Yellowstone County Area Human Trafficking Task Force. | |
---
| | | [ ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=7b817f3e18&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | | Peter Willis,
One of my proudest accomplishments is co-founding the Yellowstone County Area Human Trafficking Task Force, the largest human trafficking task force in the state of Montana. This issue is deeply important to me, which is why I find it to be outrageous that my opponent, Representative Matt Rosendale, was one of seven state senators to vote against strengthening Montana’s human trafficking laws back in 2015. **The bill had bipartisan support, including from Republican Attorney General Tim Fox.** Among other provisions, the bill allows victims of human trafficking who are charged with prostitution to protect themselves from charges if they assert that they are a victim of human trafficking. As a result, more victims have been able to come forward without fear of prosecution. After the bill passed, [we have seen human sex traffickers](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=c4cc5287c6&e=2f4ec52c5e) get longer and harsher sentences, keeping our communities safer. In the past, I worked with the Montana Department of Justice, the FBI, and the United States Attorney’s Office to end human trafficking in our state. I created and hosted conferences and training events to educate the public, schools, and government agencies on issues of human trafficking, community organization, and leadership.
---
| [ ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=a723fe68c7&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| Additionally, I worked with Montana’s U.S. Congressional members to address human trafficking and Missing and Murdered Indigenous Persons (MMIP). [The Department of Justice has reported that](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=9e3071a2d0&e=2f4ec52c5e) in Montana indigenous girls and women make up 3.3 percent of the population, but 30 to 40 percent of the people missing in Montana. The disproportionate amount of indigenous women missing in our state is directly related to sex trafficking and domestic violence.
---
|
---
| | **Throughout his career, Rosendale has always served as a “no” vote for any sort of meaningful legislation that would improve the lives of residents in Montana.** This includes reducing the rate of human trafficking and violence towards women in our state. Rosendale is less interested in protecting his female constituents and more interested in obstructing a positive agenda.
---
|
On Women’s Equality Day, we should be reminded of the trailblazing women that shaped our state and the lengths we still need to go. Rosendale stands in the way when it comes to improving the lives of the women and girls in Montana. Let's send him a message on November 8th that nothing can stop our fight for progress! **_[Can I count on your support?](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=a3197e4b31&e=2f4ec52c5e)_**

**Sincerely,**

body:
it won’t be easy, but this is a fight we must win
| **Hi, my name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.**

My opponent? **_Gov. Ron DeSantis,_** one of the most dangerous Republicans nationwide.

Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it's been working.

DeSantis signed one of the first vile "Don't Say Gay" bills. He attacked Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He's even created an "elections police" unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection. [DeSantis's next act is to run for president in 2024, and that's why I'm writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov. DeSantis's national ambitions and get Florida back on track. We can accomplish both by defeating him on November 8th, so I hope you'll make a contribution today to split between my campaign for governor and Voter Protection Project.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23388?t=6&akid=4258%2E878179%2EGLKin8) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Charlie Crist and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23389?t=7&akid=4258%2E878179%2EGLKin8)

[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23391?t=9&akid=4258%2E878179%2EGLKin8)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23388?t=11&akid=4258%2E878179%2EGLKin8)
By using the governorship as a stepping stone to run for president in 2024, DeSantis has shown he doesn't have Florida's best interests at heart.

**_But I 've always put Floridians first._** From my time as a state senator to serving as Florida's 44th governor, I've lived my life by the Golden Rule, working to build unity rather than fueling division.

Fortunately, Floridians are waking up to Ron DeSantis's horrible agenda. Multiple polls have shown me either neck and neck with him or outright beating him, so I know this fight is winnable. DeSantis only won by 0.4% in 2018. A recent _Axios_ article said "Florida swing voters view Ron DeSantis as too extreme."

Beating DeSantis won't be easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.
[Together, we can make Ron DeSantis a one-term governor and ensure he never steps foot anywhere near the White House. Can I count on you for a donation that will be split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23388?t=12&akid=4258%2E878179%2EGLKin8)
